pages.title: 技能寶石
pages.note: 技能、輔助與精魂寶石名稱。等級、品質請用數值條件。產生的片段會避開其他寶石的名稱、標籤與說明文字。

hiddenZh: 法術, 增益效果, 持續時間
法術,增益效果,持續時間
借助三曲烈焰的力量以強化你施放的下一個可爆發法術。強化的法術會以你的位置為中心，並以三曲的形狀同時以6個額外區域為目標爆發。
hiddenEn: Tap into the power of the Triskelion Flame to Empower the next Cascadable Spell you cast. The Empowered Spell becomes centred on your location, and Cascades to six areas around you in a Triskelion pattern.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 物理, 持續時間, 可重複
法術,範圍效果,物理,持續時間,可重複
如果一名敵人處於撲殺門檻內，則傳送至目標體內，使其發生劇烈爆炸；反之則為其施加減益，使其在減益持續時間內若生命降至撲殺門檻時觸發同樣的效果。傳送時目標會被摧毀，且爆炸會對周圍的敵人造成物理傷害並施加穿刺。
hiddenEn: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the Cull threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a Debuff to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the Cull threshold during its duration. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Physical damage to surrounding enemies and inflicts Impale.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 物理, 混沌, 持續時間, 可重複
法術,範圍效果,物理,混沌,持續時間,可重複
召喚一顆從無光深淵升起的恐怖頭骨啃咬敵人，對目標位置造成大量傷害並在該位置產生凋零地面。若指定近距離的目標，則施放時會使你向後跳躍。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Physical, Chaos, Duration, Repeatable

Conjure a horrific skull rising from the lightless depths to bite your enemies dealing high damage at target location and leaving Withering Ground in its wake. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 投射物, 閃電, 持續時間, 可重複
法術,範圍效果,投射物,閃電,持續時間,可重複
召喚出在你上方盤旋並發出爆鳴的電湧之靈。在短時間後，電湧之靈飛向敵人，擊中時對一片範圍造成閃電傷害，並優先挑選最後一個作為目標的敵人為目標。重新施放此法術會重置所有現有電湧之靈的持續時間。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Projectile, Lightning, Duration, Repeatable

Conjure a crackling Wellsprite that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Wellsprite launches at an enemy, dealing Lightning damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Wellsprites.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 盟友, 持續時間
召喚深淵之靈，在一段時間內阻礙一名稀有不死族。若在該不死族阻礙時擊敗它，則可將其捕獲並儲存於靈魂水晶技能寶石中。擁有強大深淵力量的使用者可利用靈魂水晶召喚被束縛的不死族作為復甦盟友。
hiddenEn: Conjure Abyssal spirits to Hinder a Rare Undead for a duration. If you defeat the Undead while it is Hindered, it will be captured and stored into a Soul Crystal Skill Gem. The Soul Crystal will allow a wielder of great Abyssal power to summon the bound Undead as a Reviving Companion.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 觸發, 火焰, 遣散
法術,範圍效果,觸發,火焰,遣散
召喚一把深淵鐮刀橫掃指定區域，對敵人造成火焰傷害並消耗點燃以產生火柱。無法受觸發。
hiddenEn: Conjure an abyssal scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing Fire damage to enemies and Consuming Ignite to create pillars of flame. Cannot be Triggered.

hiddenZh: 法術, 增益效果, 範圍效果, 冰冷, 風暴
法術,增益效果,範圍效果,冰冷,風暴
產生一道死亡能量風暴，身處其中會強化消耗魔力的法術，對其附加 冰冷 傷害。維持風暴會持續消耗你的魔力，施放越多法術會使魔力消耗更快。隨著風暴持續，它會製造出緩慢擴大的冰緩地面。進入風暴中心的敵人會被致盲。當你離開範圍或魔力耗盡時，風暴便會結束並釋放出一道死亡浪潮，對冰緩地面上的敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: DNT-UNUSED Create a storm of deathly energies that Empowers your Mana-costing Spells with Cold damage while you remain inside it. Maintaining the storm constantly drains your Mana, and spending more causes it to drain faster. As the storm persists it creates slowly expanding Chilled Ground. Enemies that enter the eye of the storm are Blinded. When you leave the storm, or run out of Mana, the storm ends and unleashes a death-wave, damaging enemies on the Chilled Ground.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 觸發, 閃電, 連鎖
攻擊,範圍效果,觸發,閃電,連鎖
消耗符文保護使一組電塔在你面前升起，在電塔之間架起一座雷電之牆，對其中的敵人造成傷害並使其觸電。你發射的投射物在穿透牆體時會被充能，並在擊中敵人時以連鎖閃電光束的形式釋放能量。
hiddenEn: Spend Runic Ward to raise a pair of electrified pylons in front of you which project a wall of electricity between them, damaging and Electrocuting enemies caught between them. Projectiles you fire through the wall become energised, and discharge that energy on Hit as Chaining Lightning beams.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 閃電, 持續時間, 危險
攻擊,範圍效果,閃電,持續時間,危險
消耗符文保護以在你正前方的錐形區域內創造數個危險符文，這些符文需要一段時間才能武裝。武裝後，當敵人踩上這些符文時會使其啟動並爆炸，造成不基於你武器傷害的攻擊傷害並施加觸電累積。
hiddenEn: Spend Runic Ward to create a number of Hazardous Runes in a cone in front of you, which arm after a time. After arming, these Runes will activate when enemies step on them, exploding to deal Attack damage that is not based on your Weapon's damage and apply Electrocution buildup.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續時間
獻祭一個稀有怪物的屍體，賦予你持續一段時間的該怪物詞綴，或是以自身生命能量作為代價以獲得一條隨機的詞綴。
hiddenEn: Sacrifice the Corpse of a Rare Monster to grant you its Modifiers for a duration, or gain a single random Modifier at the cost of your own life force.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 閃電, 冰冷, 火焰, 新星, 遣散
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,閃電,冰冷,火焰,新星,遣散
將你的長矛刺入地面來造成一道會消耗附近數名敵人、友方和屍體所附帶的冰凍、感電和點燃效果的脈衝。該脈衝不會造成傷害，但每消耗一個異常狀態，便會造成一次對應元素傷害類型的爆炸。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Melee, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Nova, Payoff

Plunge your Spear into the ground to emit a pulse that Consumes Freeze, Shock and Ignite on a number of nearby enemies, Allies and Corpses. The pulse itself deals no damage, but each Ailment Consumed causes an explosion of the corresponding elemental damage type.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 觸發, 閃電, 冰冷, 火焰
攻擊,範圍效果,觸發,閃電,冰冷,火焰
賦予你的武器波動。該武器的非近戰投射物攻擊會消耗波動，使得射出的投射物在抵達飛行終點時爆炸。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire
Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 閃電, 冰冷, 火焰, 持續時間
攻擊,近戰,打擊,閃電,冰冷,火焰,持續時間
朝一名敵人衝刺，並使他們的抗性無效化。擊中一名帶有正值元素抗性的敵人會使其最高元素抗性在一段時間內降為 0，並觸發灌注武器，根據移除的抗性來賦予你的長矛相對應的可能最大元素波動。若這個技能沒有移除任何抗性，冷卻時間便會重置。這個技能無法受到先祖強化。
hiddenEn: Attack, Melee, Strike, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration

Dash to an enemy and nullify their Resistance. Hitting an enemy with positive Elemental Resistance will reduce their highest Elemental Resistance to 0 for a duration and triggers Infuse Weapon, granting your Spear the maximum possible Surges corresponding to the removed Resistance. If this skill doesn't remove any Resistances, its cooldown is reset. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 投射物, 觸發, 閃電, 冰冷, 火焰, 連鎖
法術,範圍效果,投射物,觸發,閃電,冰冷,火焰,連鎖
製造烈炎爆炸、電弧弩箭或冰之波動的投射物。爆炸的機率與你的力量成正比；弩箭的機率與你的敏捷成正比；波動的機率與你的智慧成正比。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Projectile, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Chaining

Create a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave of projectiles. The chance for an explosion is proportional to your Strength, for a bolt proportional to your Dexterity, and for a wave proportional to your Intelligence.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 閃電, 冰冷, 火焰, 持續時間, 詛咒, 可重複
法術,範圍效果,閃電,冰冷,火焰,持續時間,詛咒,可重複
在短暫延遲後，對一片區域內的所有目標降下詛咒，降低其元素抗性。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration, Curse, Repeatable
Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Elemental Resistances.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 觸發, 閃電, 冰冷, 火焰, 持續時間, 球體
法術,範圍效果,觸發,閃電,冰冷,火焰,持續時間,球體
在指定位置創造一道火焰、冰冷或閃電靜止風暴，並持續存在一段時間，以擊中而觸發風暴的最高元素傷害類型為依據。擊中無法造成元素傷害則不會觸發風暴。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration, Orb

Create a stationary Fire, Cold or Lightning storm at a target location for a duration, based on the highest Elemental Damage type for the Hit that Triggered the storm. Hits which do not deal Elemental Damage will not Trigger the storm.

hiddenZh: 法術, 攻擊, 增益效果, 範圍效果, 閃電, 持續時間, 條件
法術,攻擊,增益效果,範圍效果,閃電,持續時間,條件
消耗所有暴擊球為你的細杖充入電能，使細杖攻擊附加閃電傷害和一道閃電震波。在增益效果作用期間再次使用此技能會提升增益效果的持續時間以及傷害。
hiddenEn: Spell, Attack, Buff, AoE, Lightning, Duration, Conditional

Consume all Power Charges to charge your Quarterstaff with electricity, adding Lightning damage and a Lightning shockwave to your Quarterstaff Attacks. Reusing this skill while the Buff is active adds to the Buff's duration and damage.

hiddenZh: 戰吼, 變形, 熊, 範圍效果, 新星, 主要
戰吼,變形,熊,範圍效果,新星,主要
變形成巨熊型態並以防禦姿態嘶吼，如果周遭有敵人的話則立即獲得盛怒，且強化隨後的攻擊，使其護甲破壞。如果在此技能的插槽中插入人類型態的戰吼，則此技能會在施放時改為觸發該戰吼，並且增幅其傷害和範圍。可透過消耗一顆耐力球而重置此技能的冷卻時間。
hiddenEn: Warcry, Shapeshift, Bear, AoE, Nova, Meta

Shapeshift into a Bear and roar in defiance, immediately gaining Rage if there are enemies nearby and Empowering subsequent Attacks to Break Armour. Alternatively, socketing a human-form Warcry into this Skill triggers that Warcry instead, and augments its damage and area. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 觸發, 持續時間
此技能會於你召喚圖騰時觸發，召喚一個先祖之靈召喚物為你作戰。若召喚出召喚物的圖騰死亡，由其觸發的先祖之靈也會死亡。
hiddenEn: This skill is Triggered each time you summon a Totem, summoning an Ancestral Spirit Minion to fight for you. If the Totem dies then the Ancestral Spirit triggered by it's summoning will die too.

hiddenZh: 戰吼, 攻擊, 增益效果, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊, 投射物, 觸發, 火焰, 持續時間, 新星, 條件
戰吼,攻擊,增益效果,範圍效果,近戰,重擊,投射物,觸發,火焰,持續時間,新星,條件
運用點燃敵人所獲得的榮耀發出一聲戰吼，讓你成為岡姆的化身。在岡姆的化身作用期間，你踏過的地方會觸發熔火步伐，近戰打擊和重擊會受到先祖強化，且你的近戰打擊會觸發火山迸發。
hiddenEn: Warcry, Attack, Buff, AoE, Melee, Slam, Projectile, Trigger, Fire, Duration, Nova, Conditional

Perform a Warcry using Glory gained by Igniting enemies to turn you into an embodiment of Kaom. While embodying Kaom, you Trigger Volcanic Steps while travelling, Melee Strikes and Slams are Ancestrally Boosted, and your Melee Strikes Trigger Volcanic Eruption.

hiddenZh: 圖騰, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 持續時間, 條件, 主要
圖騰,攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,持續時間,條件,主要
消耗 3 個耐力球呼喚一個蘊含靈魂戰士的圖騰。每一名戰士都會在使用插槽中的錘技能一次後消失。無法使用引導技能或有冷卻時間的技能。
hiddenEn: Totem, Attack, AoE, Melee, Duration, Conditional, Meta
Consume 3 Endurance Charges to Raise a Totem that conjures spirit warriors. Each warrior uses a socketed Mace Skill once, then disappears. Cannot use Channelling Skills or Skills with Cooldowns.

hiddenZh: 號令, 範圍效果, 物理, 引導
號令,範圍效果,物理,引導
號令, 範圍效果, 物理, 持續時間
號令,範圍效果,物理,持續時間
攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 持續性, 物理, 引導
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,持續性,物理,引導
以武器反覆錘打自己所持的盾牌，在自身周圍產生傷害性震波。遭震波擊中的敵人會在一段時間內損失護甲。引導共鳴之盾時，你會舉起盾牌並格擋所有來襲的可格擋擊中。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Melee, Sustained, Physical, Channelling

Repeatedly hammer your Shield with your weapon causing damaging shockwaves in an area around you. Enemies hit by the shockwave lose Armour for a duration. While Channelling Resonating Shield, your Shield is raised and you will Block all incoming Blockable hits.

hiddenZh: 引導以回復能量護盾。允許充能至溢出。引導會在你受到傷害或能量護盾達到平時上限的兩倍時結束。當你的能量護盾已達平常上限的兩倍，或是並無能量護盾上限時，則無法使用此技能。
hiddenEn: Channel to Recharge Energy Shield and allow that Recharge to Overflow. Channelling ends when you take damage or your Energy Shield is fully Overflowed.

hiddenZh: 印記, 增益效果, 冰冷, 持續時間
印記,增益效果,冰冷,持續時間
對一個目標施加印記，使其更容易被冰凍。當帶有印記的目標被冰凍時，印記會啟動並獲得一個給予額外冰冷傷害的增益效果。當你有增益效果時，對其他目標施加印記會移除該增益效果。
hiddenEn: Mark a target, making them more susceptible to being Frozen. When the Marked target is Frozen, the Mark Activates, granting you a Buff which gives extra Cold damage and Consuming the Mark. Marking another target while you have the Buff will remove the Buff.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 冰冷, 可重複
法術,投射物,冰冷,可重複
發射寒冰投射物掃射弧形範圍。同一敵人可能遭多個投射物擊中。
hiddenEn: Launch icy Projectiles in a sweeping arc. Multiple Projectiles can hit the same enemy.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 冰冷, 遣散
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,冰冷,遣散
向上方揮掃你的細杖，釋放出寒冰波動造成多次傷害，以及最後一下的高爆發傷害。最後一段高爆發傷害會對冰凍敵人造成極高傷害，但也會消耗冰凍效果。被最後的爆發傷害擊中的冰晶會爆炸。
hiddenEn: Sweep your Quarterstaff upwards, releasing an icy fissure which deals damage in a series of bursts culminating in a large spike. Frozen enemies hit by the final spike are dealt heavy damage but the Freeze is Consumed. Ice Crystals hit by the final spike explode.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 投射物, 冰冷, 持續時間, 可重複
攻擊,範圍效果,投射物,冰冷,持續時間,可重複
投擲一把穿透長槍，在其路徑上留下寒冰碎片。碎片會冰緩附近的敵人。在可能的情況下會消耗一個狂怒球，使第一個投射物產生的冰霜碎片在短時間後向外爆發，以彈片擊打敵人。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Projectile, Cold, Duration, Repeatable

Throw a single Piercing lance that leaves icy fragments in its wake. The fragments Chill nearby enemies. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to cause the glacial fragments created by the first Projectile to explode outwards after a short duration, peppering enemies with shrapnel.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 彈藥, 投射物, 冰冷, 持續時間
攻擊,範圍效果,彈藥,投射物,冰冷,持續時間
使用寒冰弩箭裝填你的十字弓，抵達飛行終點時會豎立起兩道冰晶之牆。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Ammunition, Projectile, Cold, Duration
Load your Crossbow with icy bolts that create two walls of Ice Crystals at the end of their flight.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 冰冷, 持續時間
法術,範圍效果,冰冷,持續時間
創造出一道由冰晶構成、可阻隔敵人的牆。冰晶損壞到一定程度，或受到足夠的推力時會爆炸，並對周圍敵人造成傷害。遭摧毀時，在情況許可下，會消耗一道閃電灌注，加入另一個閃電爆炸。
hiddenEn: Create a wall of Ice Crystals which holds back enemies. The Crystals explode if sufficiently damaged, or if pushed hard enough, damaging nearby enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to add another Lightning explosion if destroyed.

hiddenZh: 法術, 攻擊, 增益效果, 範圍效果, 投射物, 觸發, 冰冷, 持續時間
法術,攻擊,增益效果,範圍效果,投射物,觸發,冰冷,持續時間
準備你目前使用中的弓或長矛，強化你下一次可重複的弓攻擊或投射物長矛攻擊，使其將物理傷害轉換為冰冷傷害，並在擊中時觸發寒冰碎片。此技能的冷卻時間可藉由消耗 1 個狂怒球無視。無法強化持續性技能。
hiddenEn: Spell, Attack, Buff, AoE, Projectile, Trigger, Cold, Duration

Ready your active Bow or Spear, Empowering your next Repeatable Bow or Projectile Spear Attacks to Convert Physical Damage to Cold Damage and Trigger Ice Fragments on Hit. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge. Cannot Empower Sustained Skills.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 彈藥, 投射物, 持續性, 冰冷
攻擊,範圍效果,彈藥,投射物,持續性,冰冷
被動地以等同於裝填時間的頻率產生冰雹彈藥，直到達到一定上限。啟動後會將累積的冰箭 裝填進你的十字弓中。所有裝填的冰箭會同時射出，並如雨點般傾瀉在目標區域。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Ammunition, Projectile, Sustained, Cold

Passively generate bolts of ice at a frequency equal to reload time, up to a cap. Activate to Load the accumulated bolts into your Crossbow. All loaded bolts are fired at once, causing them to rain down over the target area.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 冰冷, 可重複
攻擊,投射物,冰冷,可重複
射出一支冰箭，在擊中一個目標時朝扇形範圍內噴出碎冰。
hiddenEn: Fire an icy arrow that sprays a cone of ice shards when it hits a target.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 冰冷, 持續時間, 新星, 可重複
法術,範圍效果,冰冷,持續時間,新星,可重複
朝所有方向施展一道寒冰之潮，根據敵人與你的距離造成擊退。如果在寒冰彈投射物附近施放冰霜新星，則會改為從寒冰彈釋放，而非你身上。情況許可時，會消耗一道冰冷灌注，產生一塊冰緩地面。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Cold, Duration, Nova, Repeatable

Conjure a wave of ice in all directions, Knocking Back enemies based on how close they are to you. Casting Ice Nova targeting near a Frostbolt Projectile will cause it to originate from the Frostbolt instead of you. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to leave a patch of Chilled Ground.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續性, 冰冷, 持續時間, 遣散, 可重複, 風暴
法術,範圍效果,持續性,冰冷,持續時間,遣散,可重複,風暴
呼喚無數寒冰彈如冰雹一般灑落在目標區域。前方敵人身上的冰緩和冰凍會被消耗，透過製造強化冰彈為冰風暴提供燃料。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Sustained, Cold, Duration, Payoff, Repeatable, Storm
Conjure a hail of icy bolts over the targeted area. Chill and Freeze on enemies in front of you are Consumed to fuel the Icestorm by creating improved bolts.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 投射物, 冰冷, 可重複
攻擊,範圍效果,投射物,冰冷,可重複
被動地隨時間獲得封印。使用此技能時會發射一個投射物並破除封印，每有一個封印便重複一次，且此技能每獲得一個額外投射物也會重複一次。每次此技能正常重複時，若可行，也會額外重複一次，以效果範圍內另一個寒冰碎片為目標，並立即引爆那些寒冰碎片。
hiddenEn: Passively gains Seals over time. Using the skill fires a projectile, and breaks the Seals, Repeating for each of them, and for each additional projectile the skill is given. For each time it Repeats normally, it will also Repeat an additional time targeting a different Ice Fragment in its area of effect if able, Detonating those Ice Fragments immediately.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 冰冷
發射一個本身不會擊中敵人的眼球投射物。眼球在飛行過程中會持續釋放出呈螺旋形分布、造成傷害的碎片投射物。如果眼球通過元素地面或球體，則會獲得該地表的效果，使碎片造成對應類型且更高的傷害。
hiddenEn: Fire a single Eye Projectile which does not Hit enemies. The Eye constantly releases damaging shard Projectiles in a spiral as it flies. If the Eye passes over an Elemental Ground Surface or Orb, it will take on that surface's effect causing shards to deal more damage of the corresponding Type.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 增益效果, 範圍效果, 觸發, 持續時間
攻擊,增益效果,範圍效果,觸發,持續時間
將你的符文保護傾瀉至凝聚的刀刃之中。在增益效果期間，這些刀刃會落於你的投射物攻擊擊中的敵人。
hiddenEn: Pour your Runic Ward into conjuring blades. For the duration of the Buff, these blades fall on enemies Hit by your Projectile Attacks.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 彈藥, 投射物, 遣散, 融合
攻擊,範圍效果,彈藥,投射物,遣散,融合
使用分裂彈藥裝填你的十字弓。其會發射飛行時分裂的穿透弩箭。弩箭擊中冰凍的敵人時會消耗冰凍效果，並引發寒冰碎片爆炸。這些碎片可融合。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Ammunition, Projectile, Payoff, Merging

Load your Crossbow with Piercing bolts that fragment in flight. Bolts that hit a Frozen enemy Consume the Freeze and cause an explosion of shrapnel. Bolts that hit an Ice Crystal cause it to explode. These fragments can Merge.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 火焰, 混沌, 持續時間
法術,範圍效果,火焰,混沌,持續時間
消耗一具屍體創造出一片可燃毒霧。任何燃燒效果或引爆器技能都會引爆毒霧，造成猛烈的爆炸。
法術, 範圍效果, 觸發, 火焰, 混沌, 持續時間
法術,範圍效果,觸發,火焰,混沌,持續時間
消耗一具 屍體創造出一片可燃毒霧。任何 燃燒效果或引爆器技能都會引爆毒霧，造成猛烈的爆炸。
hiddenEn: Consume a Corpse to create a cloud of flammable Poisonous gas. Any Burning effects or Detonator skills will explode the gas cloud, creating a fiery explosion.
Spell, AoE, Trigger, Fire, Chaos, Duration

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 打擊
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,打擊
攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 打擊, 冰冷
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,打擊,冰冷
施展一次寒冰刺擊，對已經失衡的敵人造成額外效果。擊中受招架的目標時會消耗減益效果，引發寒冰爆炸並留下冰緩地面。
hiddenEn: Perform an icy stab that exploits enemies who are already off balance. Hitting a Parried target Consumes the Debuff to cause an explosion of frost and leave Chilled Ground.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 增益效果, 範圍效果, 持續時間
召喚物,增益效果,範圍效果,持續時間
用骨刺穿透一具骷髏，使附近的召喚物進入狂暴狀態，只要骨刺存在，它們的技能就會更快且傷害更高。骨刺本身也被視為召喚物。如果它死亡，效果就會立即結束。
hiddenEn: Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike to send nearby Minions into a frenzy as long as the spike remains, making their skills faster and harder hitting.
The bone spike is itself a Minion. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 打擊
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,打擊
法術, 增益效果, 閃電, 冰冷, 火焰, 持續時間, 條件
法術,增益效果,閃電,冰冷,火焰,持續時間,條件
消耗所有暴擊球來主宰元素，獲得元素傷害，以其他傷害類型施加元素異常狀態的能力。只能在暴擊球達到最大數量時使用。
hiddenEn: Spell, Buff, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration, Conditional
Consume all Power Charges to master the elements, gaining Elemental Damage and the ability to apply Elemental Ailments with other damage types. Can only be used while you have maximum Power Charges.

hiddenZh: 嘗試剝奪一名敵人的生命力。位於撲殺範圍內的敵人會被重點標示，在被擊中時立即被擊殺，並賦予一顆暴擊球。只能以撲殺範圍內的敵人作為目標。
hiddenEn: Attempt to rip the lifeforce from an enemy. Enemies within Culling range will be highlighted and instantly killed on Hit, granting a Power Charge. Can only target Enemies in Culling range.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 持續性, 條件, 疾風
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,持續性,條件,疾風
消耗所有狂怒球，執行一次會擊退敵人的巨型長矛突刺。每消耗一個狂怒球，長矛經過會產生一隻勁風蝮蛇。每隻蝮蛇會對敵人造成傷害並擊退他們。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Melee, Sustained, Conditional, Wind

Consume all Frenzy Charges to perform a gigantic spear thrust that Knocks Back enemies. For each Frenzy Charge consumed, a Wind Serpent follows in the spear's wake. Each Serpent also damages and Knocks Back enemies.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 物理, 引導
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,物理,引導

DNT Raise your Crossbow to Block all incoming Blockable hits. Releasing performs a Kinetic Bash, damaging enemies in front of you dealing more damage based on your Heavy Stun Buildup. While your Crossbow is raised Blocking too much damage may Heavy Stun you.
hiddenEn: DNT Raise your Crossbow to Block all incoming Blockable hits. Releasing performs a Kinetic Bash, damaging enemies in front of you dealing more damage based on your Heavy Stun Buildup. While your Crossbow is raised Blocking too much damage may Heavy Stun you.

hiddenZh: 法術, 增益效果, 物理, 持續時間
法術,增益效果,物理,持續時間
消耗所有翠玉疊層，每層消耗的翠玉都會根據你的最大生命賦予守護。當你擁有守護時無法獲得翠玉疊層。
hiddenEn: Consume all stacks of Jade to grant Guard based off your maximum Life for each Jade consumed. You cannot gain Jade stacks while you have Guard.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 打擊
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,打擊
以你的雙匕首施展打擊。
攻擊, 彈藥, 投射物
使用十字弓發射一支弩箭。
hiddenEn: Fire a bolt from your crossbow.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊, 投射物, 物理, 冰冷, 快行
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,重擊,投射物,物理,冰冷,快行
將你的盾牌當作投射物擲出，其會於飛行至最大距離時迴旋。此技能在盾牌飛行途中會被夜殞之擁取代。以夜殞之擁破壞冰晶或接住迴旋的盾牌會無視此技能的冷卻時間。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Melee, Slam, Projectile, Physical, Cold, Travel

Hurl your Shield as a Projectile which Returns to you at the end of its flight. While the Shield is in flight, this skill is replaced with Embrace the Fall. This skill's cooldown is skipped if you catch the Shield as it Returns, or destroy an Ice Crystal with the Embrace the Fall.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 打擊, 閃電, 遣散
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,打擊,閃電,遣散
使出一次閃電充能刺擊，最多可以透過三次攻擊連鎖成組合技。前兩次攻擊若擊中感電敵人，便會召喚一個衝鋒荒林魂靈並重置感電持續時間。第三次攻擊是一次大範圍的掃擊，可造成元素曝曬，且會消耗感電以召喚一波魂靈的踐踏。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Melee, Strike, Lightning, Payoff

Perform a Lightning-charged stab that can be chained into a combination of up to three attacks. The first two attacks conjure a charging Wildwood spirit if they Hit a Shocked enemy and refresh Shock duration. The third attack is a large swipe that inflicts Elemental Exposure, and can Consume Shock to conjure a stampede of spirits.

hiddenZh: 強化下一個由你使用的投射物技能，使其創造額外投射物並飛的更快。
hiddenEn: Empowers the next Projectile Skill you use, causing it to create additional Projectiles and fly faster.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 新星
釋放一道暫時的新星 並利用敵人露出的可趁之機。擊中可暈眩、可觸電、或是可冰凍的敵人會創造一道他們的幻象，幻象的持續時間等同於原目標用於創造分身所承受的禁錮效果持續時間。對幻象所造成的傷害有一部分會轉移至原主。
hiddenEn: Send out a temporal Nova to take advantage of enemies' moment of vulnerability. Hitting enemies that are Primed for Stun, Electrocution, or Freeze causes a visage of them to appear, lasting as long as the original target would have been affected by the form of Immobilisation used to create the visage. A portion of the damage dealt to visages is also dealt to the original.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 變形, 龍, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊
攻擊,變形,龍,範圍效果,近戰,重擊
變形 成 飛龍型態並吞噬一具屍體或可撲殺的敵人，以及額外的周遭屍體。根據每一吞噬的敵人或屍體數量回復自身生命並獲得一顆暴擊球。如果目標距離夠遠，則會跳躍至目標並對著地位置周遭敵人造成傷害。當以周遭敵人或屍體做為目標時並不會跳躍或重擊。
hiddenEn: Attack, Shapeshift, Wyvern, AoE, Melee, Slam

Shapeshift into a Wyvern and devour a Corpse or Cullable enemy, and additional nearby Corpses. For each enemy or corpse devoured, you regenerate life and gain a Power Charge. If the target is far enough away, you will leap to them and damage nearby enemies where you land. Targeting nearby enemies or corpses will not perform a leap or a Slam.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 可重複
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,可重複
在短暫延遲後減益一片區域內的所有目標，使其受到的一部分擊中傷害被減益效果追蹤。當減益效果的持續時間結束或目標會被其擊殺時，他們會失去等同於追蹤傷害的生命。
hiddenEn: Debuff all targets in an area, causing a portion of Damage they take from Hits to be tracked by the Debuff. When the debuff's duration expires or can kill the target, the target loses life equal to that tracked damage all at once.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 獲得疊層
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,獲得疊層
放置 1 個咒符於地面，給予在範圍內的你和友方強大的法術傷害增益效果。當你站在咒符範圍內時，消耗越多的魔力，增益效果就會變得越強大。
hiddenEn: Place a Sigil on the ground, providing a powerful Spell Damage Buff to you and Allies while standing in it. The Buff becomes more powerful the more mana you spend while standing in the Sigil.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 混沌, 遣散, 可重複
法術,範圍效果,混沌,遣散,可重複
引爆區域內所有敵人身上的一個詛咒，造成帶有混沌傷害的爆炸，但同時移除該詛咒。只能引爆持續時間至少剩下一半的詛咒。
hiddenEn: Detonate a Curse on every enemy in an area, causing explosions of Chaos damage but removing the Curse. Can only detonate Curses for which at least half of the duration has expired.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 彈藥, 投射物, 持續性
攻擊,範圍效果,彈藥,投射物,持續性
使用圍城爆發裝填你的十字弓，其會在目標範圍內所有敵人附近掉落一支追蹤弩箭。這些弩箭會停留在地面，並在短暫延遲後爆炸。
hiddenEn: Load your Crossbow with enemy-seeking payloads which are fired into the air, dropping a bolt near every enemy in the target area. These bolts lodge in the ground and explode after a short delay.

hiddenZh: 戰吼, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 觸發, 物理, 持續時間, 新星
戰吼,攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,觸發,物理,持續時間,新星
發出一聲戰吼，該戰吼賦予守護，並使後續盾牌攻擊造成傷害時觸發盾之波動。消耗耐力球可略過此技能的冷卻時間。

Dash to an enemy and Strike them, triggering socketed Marks with increased effect and applying socketed Curses with increased duration.

hiddenEn: Buff, Attack, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Chaos, Duration, Conditional, Storm
Build Glory by dealing Chaos damage to enemies. When you have maximum Glory, you can entreat the Dreamer to inhabit you, briefly becoming his Archon.

攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,重擊,持續時間,遣散
重擊地面，造成一波翻騰的裂縫，對你前方一連串區域內的敵人造成傷害。被波浪擊中的敵人中的一些將釋放一道震波，對其他敵人造成傷害。擊中完全破甲的敵人時，會施加破碎護甲，使其承受額外物理傷害增加。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Melee, Slam, Duration, Payoff

Slam the ground, creating a roiling fissure that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies. Hitting an enemy with Fully Broken Armour applies Sundered Armour, making it take additional increased Physical damage.

hiddenZh: 法術, 召喚物, 範圍效果, 物理, 冰冷, 條件, 可重複
法術,召喚物,範圍效果,物理,冰冷,條件,可重複
透過消耗符文保護以累積榮耀。當你達到最大榮耀時，你可以從天穹之上呼喚一團質量巨大的維里西姆，在目標位置造成高額傷害並召喚一名暫時召喚物。以距離你較近的位置為目標時，則會使你施法時向後跳躍。若允許，則會消耗一個維里西姆灌注以增加召喚的召喚物數量。
hiddenEn: Spell, Minion, AoE, Physical, Cold, Conditional, Repeatable

Build Glory by spending Runic Ward. When you have maximum Glory, you may call down a mass of Verisium from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location and summoning a Temporary Minion. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. Consumes a Verisium Infusion, if possible, to increase the number of Minions summoned.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 投射物, 持續性, 閃電, 持續時間, 連鎖, 可重複

hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Projectile, Sustained, Lightning, Duration, Chaining, Repeatable

Fire a slow-moving Projectile that moves through enemies. The Projectile itself does not Hit enemies, but repeatedly discharges bolts of Lightning at nearby enemies. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to slow down over time, create Ignited Ground as it travels, and explode dealing Fire damage in an Area after it dissipates.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 持續時間, 新星
法術,範圍效果,持續時間,新星
在你周圍創造一片奉獻地面。
hiddenEn: Create an area of Consecrated Ground around you.

攻擊,範圍效果,彈藥,投射物,冰冷,條件
你武器中罪魂會被動累積悲痛。充能完成時，使用此技能會譜成安魂曲，將你的十字弓射擊轉換為一道無盡悲痛，持續一小段固定時間。不會使用彈藥。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Ammunition, Projectile, Cold, Conditional

Your weapon passively accumulates anguish from the tormented souls within. When fully charged, use this skill to compose the Requiem, transforming your Crossbow shot into a torrent of anguish for a short, fixed amount of time. Does not use Ammunition.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 打擊, 火焰, 引導
攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,打擊,火焰,引導
引導來為你的武器充入火焰。在完美時機施放會產生一道會造成傷害的熾烈火焰波動。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Melee, Strike, Fire, Channelling
Channel to charge up your weapon with Fire. Releasing with Perfect Timing will create a damaging wave of intense Fire.

hiddenZh: 法術, 投射物, 混沌, 可重複
法術,投射物,混沌,可重複
同時朝目標發射一發物理和一發混沌投射物。這些投射物可以沒有上限的從受詛咒的目標處連鎖。
hiddenEn: Simultaneously fires a Physical Projectile and a Chaos Projectile at the target. These projectiles Chain through any number of Cursed targets.

hiddenEn: Fire a slow-moving Piercing Projectile that is effective at Chilling enemies and explodes on colliding with terrain.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 冰冷

向後翻並朝你前方釋放一道冰凍波，將可冰凍的敵人立即冰凍。
hiddenEn: Flip backwards and send forth a Freezing wave in front of you, immediately Freezing enemies which are Primed for Freeze.

Load your Crossbow with a clip of icy bolts that rapidly fire at the ground, leaving a shard of ice at the impact location that arms after a duration. After arming, the ice shards explode when enemies step on them, dealing more damage the longer they have been armed, up to a maximum. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 冰冷, 持續時間

hiddenEn: Leap backward and crack the ground with your staff to call forth an Ice Crystal which can be damaged by you and enemies. If the Crystal is destroyed it causes an icy explosion. This skill can be used while using other skills.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 投射物, 冰冷, 遣散, 可重複
法術,範圍效果,投射物,冰冷,遣散,可重複
朝目標施放一定數量的寒冰投射物。Projectiles|投射物擊中受冰緩或冰凍的目標時，會產生冰岩，在撞擊地面時造成額外傷害。情況許可時，會消耗一道冰冷灌注，使得每一個投射物卡入敵人體內，接著爆炸。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Projectile, Cold, Payoff, Repeatable

Conjures a number of icy Projectiles that launch towards the target. Projectiles that Hit a Chilled or Frozen target create chunks of ice that deal additional damage on impacting the ground. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to cause each Projectile to lodge into the enemy then explode.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 冰冷, 持續時間, 球體, 痕跡

hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Cold, Duration, Orb, Remnant

Create a pulsing Orb of frost. Each pulse inflicts Elemental Exposure on nearby enemies. When the Orb's duration ends, it Detonates, dealing Cold damage to surrounding enemies and leaving behind a Cold Infusion.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 閃電
召喚閃電擊中你面前扇形範圍內的所有敵人，對感電敵人造成顯著更多傷害。如果目標區域內有感電敵人，額外的雷彈會在擊中的目標間分配。目標位置離你較近時，施展此技能會使你朝後方跳躍。
hiddenEn: Call down Lightning to hit all enemies in a cone in front of you, dealing significantly more damage to Shocked enemies. If there is a Shocked enemy in the target area, additional lightning bolts are distributed among the targets hit. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 閃電, 持續時間, 詛咒, 可重複
法術,範圍效果,閃電,持續時間,詛咒,可重複
在短暫延遲後，對一片區域內的所有目標降下詛咒，降低其閃電抗性。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Lightning, Duration, Curse, Repeatable
Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Lightning Resistance.

hiddenZh: 法術, 召喚物, 範圍效果, 物理, 持續時間, 可重複
法術,召喚物,範圍效果,物理,持續時間,可重複
從你前方的土中升起骨刺，對敵人造成傷害。從範圍內的屍體以及死亡的復甦召喚物抽取骨頭，拼裝為短暫存在的骨骼創造物召喚物來為你戰鬥。較大的屍體可創造出一個以上的骨骼創造物。
hiddenEn: Spell, Minion, AoE, Physical, Duration, Repeatable

Raise spikes of bone from the earth in front of you, damaging enemies. The bones of Corpses and dead Reviving Minions in the area are ripped out and reassembled into short-lived Bone Construct Minions that fight for you. Larger Corpses create more than one Bone Construct.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 物理, 火焰, 引爆器, 可重複

使一具屍體引發劇烈爆炸，對周圍的敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Spell, AoE, Physical, Fire, Detonator, Repeatable
Cause a Corpse to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 物理, 引導

舉起你的盾牌來格擋所有來襲的可格擋擊中。當附近有敵人時，在格擋後立即釋放以使出一次盾牌重擊，對敵人造成傷害並使其暈眩。當你舉起盾牌且成功格擋擊中時，不會因其被輕微暈眩，但格擋過多傷害可能會導致你被沉重暈眩。當你舉起盾牌時無法閃避，但閃避會賦予同等的機率來避免該沉重暈眩累積。
hiddenEn: Raise your Shield to Block all incoming Blockable hits. Release immediately after Blocking when an enemy is close to perform a Shield Bash, damaging and Stunning enemies. While your Shield is raised you cannot be Light Stunned by hits you Block, but Blocking too much damage may Heavy Stun you. You cannot Evade while your Shield is raised, but Evasion instead grants an equal chance to avoid this Heavy Stun buildup.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 變形, 熊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊, 持續性, 持續時間, 引導
攻擊,變形,熊,範圍效果,近戰,重擊,持續性,持續時間,引導
變形成巨熊型態並猛擊地面數次，創造會在你面前以弧形大幅隨機穿梭的熔岩裂縫。
hiddenEn: Attack, Shapeshift, Bear, AoE, Melee, Slam, Sustained, Duration, Channelling
Shapeshift into a Bear and repeatedly pound the ground, creating Molten Fissures that travel randomly in a wide arc in front of you.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊, 投射物, 閃電

為你的細杖浸染電能，接著重擊地面，對前方大片扇形範圍內的敵人造成傷害。消耗你現有的暴擊球從撞擊中向前方發射閃電投射物。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Melee, Slam, Projectile, Lightning

Suffuse your Quarterstaff with electrical energy, then Slam the ground to deal damage in a large cone in front of you. Consumes your Power Charges to fire Lightning Projectiles forwards from the impact.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 投射物, 火焰, 持續時間, 可重複

發射一支箭矢嵌入擊中處，並持續一小段時間。持續時間結束後，箭矢會以靈體烈焰的形式爆炸，化為灰燼並對敵人造成傷害，且有高機率使其點燃。若該爆炸點燃任何敵人，則也會對範圍內的敵人施加點燃。
hiddenEn: Attack, AoE, Projectile, Fire, Duration, Repeatable

Fires an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, the arrow explodes in spectral flame, turning it to ashes and damaging enemies, with a high chance to Ignite. Igniting any enemy with the Explosion also applies Ignite to enemies within range.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 投射物, 可重複
以你的弓射出一支箭矢。
hiddenEn: Fire an arrow with your Bow.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 火焰
引爆目前生命低於一定限值的友方召喚物，對附近敵人造成高額攻擊傷害。
hiddenEn: Detonate an allied Minion whose current Life is below a threshold, dealing heavy Attack damage to nearby enemies.

hiddenZh: 法術, 增益效果, 持續時間

準備一波箭矢或長矛，強化你下一次可重複的弓或投射物長矛攻擊，使其重複多次。使用時消耗你的狂怒球，以追加額外重複次數。
hiddenEn: Ready a volley of arrows or spears, Empowering your next Repeatable Bow or Projectile Spear Attack to Repeat multiple times. Consumes your Frenzy Charges on use to add additional repeats.

hiddenZh: 法術, 範圍效果, 冰冷, 可重複
法術,範圍效果,冰冷,可重複
從空中召下一塊寒冰，對目標地點造成高額傷害。瞄準你自己附近時會使你在施放時向後跳。情況許可時，會消耗一道火焰灌注來引起破壞力強大的冰冷和火焰爆發。
hiddenEn: Call down a mass of ice from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to cause a devastating blast of ice and fire.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 範圍效果, 投射物, 觸發, 持續性, 冰冷, 持續時間
