hiddenZh: 輔助會造成傷害性擊中的技能。被輔助的技能對被致盲的敵人更容易造成暴擊，並會對被致盲的敵人造成更高的暴擊傷害，但自身不會造成致盲。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills are more likely to Critically Hit Blinded Enemies, and deal more Damage with Critical Hits against Blinded Enemies, but cannot themselves inflict Blind.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 範圍效果, 觸發, 閃電, 冰冷, 火焰
輔助,法術,範圍效果,觸發,閃電,冰冷,火焰
被輔助的技能會被元素地面強化，觸發與友方強化元素地面相同類型的催化解放。
hiddenEn: Support, Spell, AoE, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire
Supports Skills which are boosted by Elemental Ground Surfaces, Triggering Catalysing Discharge of the corresponding type when they are boosted by an allied Elemental Ground Surface.

hiddenZh: 輔助會觸發其他技能的技能。由被輔助的技能所觸發的技能，在被觸發時的消耗和傷害會隨機提高或降低，且在觸發時會恢復隨機比例的消耗量。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 範圍效果, 詛咒
輔助詛咒技能，使其範圍更廣，但需要更長時間來詛咒敵人。
hiddenEn: Supports Curse skills, causing them to cover a larger area but take longer to Curse enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助會觸發其他技能的祈願技能。被輔助的技能擁有明顯更高的最大能量。
hiddenEn: Supports Invocation Skills which Trigger other Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Maximum Energy.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其造成更高的元素傷害，但無法造成異常狀態。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Elemental Damage but be unable to inflict Elemental Ailments.

hiddenZh: 輔助攻擊，使其造成更多元素傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Elemental damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助攻擊，使其造成更多元素傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Elemental damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助攻擊。被輔助的技能擊中的敵人身上每有一個元素異常狀態，便會造成更多的傷害，但被輔助的技能本身不會造成元素異常狀態。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Damage for each Elemental Ailment on Enemies they Hit. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict Elemental Ailments.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 範圍效果, 觸發, 閃電, 冰冷, 火焰, 遣散
輔助,法術,範圍效果,觸發,閃電,冰冷,火焰,遣散
輔助任何會擊中敵人的法術，使其擊中時消耗元素異常狀態，並觸發元素解放。無法輔助召喚物、或是原先已經會消耗元素異常狀態的技能。
hiddenEn: Support, Spell, AoE, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Payoff

Supports any Spell that Hits enemies, causing it to Consume Elemental Ailments on hit to trigger an Elemental Discharge. Cannot support the skills of Minions or skills which already Consume Elemental Ailments.

hiddenZh: 輔助創造召喚物的技能，提高這些召喚物的元素抗性。無法輔助創造出無法被傷害的召喚物的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports skills which create Minions, bolstering the Elemental Resistances of those Minions. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 投射物
輔助弓的攻擊。每以被輔助的技能發出三次射擊，恢復其一部分的魔力消耗，並獲得額外閃電傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills restores a portion of its Mana cost and Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 投射物
輔助弓的攻擊。每以被輔助的技能發出三次射擊，獲得額外閃電傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助可產生能量球的技能，使其在產生能量球時，有一定機率產生一顆額外的能量球。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that can generate Charges, giving them a chance to generate an additional Charge when they do so.

hiddenZh: 輔助可產生能量球的技能，使其在產生能量球時，有一定機率產生一顆額外的能量球。同時有一定機率生成額外一顆隨機類型的能量球。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that can generate Charges, giving them a chance to generate an additional Charge when they do so, as well as a chance to generate an additional Charge of a random type.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊
輔助由自身使用的打擊技能，每隔幾秒便會提供強力的先祖強化。無法輔助引導技能，且不會改變召喚物使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊
輔助由自身使用的打擊技能，每隔幾秒便會提供強力的先祖強化。無法輔助引導技能，且不會改變召喚物使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊
輔助由自身使用的打擊技能，每秒提供強力的先祖強化，但會有傷害懲罰。無法輔助引導技能，且不會改變召喚物使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every second, at the cost of a damage penalty. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 條件
輔助,攻擊,近戰,打擊,條件
輔助由自身使用的打擊。被輔助的技能在你格擋一定數量的擊中前無法使用，但使用時會受到先祖強化。使用後，這個格擋擊中計數器會重置。無法輔助引導技能，或已具有使用條件的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Strikes you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until you have Blocked a certain number of Hits, but will be Ancestrally Boosted when used. After use, this Blocked Hit counter will reset. Cannot Support Channelled Skills or Skills which already have a Condition for use.

hiddenZh: 輔助會擊中敵人的快行技能。被輔助的技能擊中滿血的敵人時會使它們目眩。
hiddenEn: Supports Travel Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against enemies on full life will Daze.

hiddenZh: 輔助十字弓技能，使過去 6 秒內由該技能裝填的每支弩箭造成更多傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Crossbow Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 6 seconds.

hiddenZh: 輔助十字弓技能，使過去 8 秒內由該技能裝填的每支弩箭造成更多傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Crossbow Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 8 seconds.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何造成傷害的技能，使其獲得冰冷傷害，但造成更少火焰和閃電傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Cold Damage but deal less Fire and Lightning Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助冰冷技能，使其獲得 1 額外等級。不能輔助沒有等級的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Cold skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 冰冷, 持續時間
輔助任何擊中敵人的技能，使冰凍敵人時造成曝曬。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when it inflicts Freeze.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何可擊中敵人的技能，使擊中穿透敵人冰冷抗性。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Cold resistance.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其能更有效地冰凍敵人。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more effective at Freezing enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 投射物, 冰冷
輔助可發射投射物的技能。當最初的投射物擊中冰凍的敵人時，被輔助的技能的投射物必定會分裂，但被輔助的技能本身不會累積冰凍。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Projectiles from Supported Skills always Fork when the initial Projectile Hits Frozen Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot build up Freeze themselves.

hiddenZh: 輔助所有會製造冰晶的技能，使它們被製造出來時有較少的生命。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with lower Life.

hiddenZh: 輔助所有會製造冰晶的技能，使它們被製造出來時有較多的生命。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with higher Life.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用、可擊中敵人的技能。當你摧毀冰晶時，被輔助的技能會獲得等同於其傷害一定百分比的冰冷傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills you use yourself which can Hit Enemies. Supported Skills Gain a percentage of their Damage as Cold Damage when you destroy Ice Crystals.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 範圍效果, 冰冷
輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其在凍結敵人周圍創造出數道冰緩地面。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to create patches of Chilled Ground around Frozen enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助具冷卻時間的技能，增加其冷卻時間恢復率速度。無法改變召喚物技能。
hiddenEn: Supports skills with Cooldowns, increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助具冷卻時間的技能，增加其冷卻時間恢復率速度。無法改變召喚物技能。
hiddenEn: Supports skills with Cooldowns, increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續增益效果技能，使被輔助的技能啟動期間施加在你身上的點燃持續時間縮短。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Ignite applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 混沌, 持續時間
輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其有一定機率在擊中時讓敵人凋零。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Wither enemies on Hit.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 範圍效果, 投射物, 觸發, 冰冷
輔助,範圍效果,投射物,觸發,冰冷
輔助會擊中敵人的技能。使其在擊殺受冰凍敵人時產生寒冰碎片。無法輔助圖騰技能，且無法修改由召喚物使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that Hit enemies, causing them to create Ice Fragments on killing Frozen Enemies. Cannot Support Totem Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 範圍效果, 觸發, 冰冷, 持續時間
輔助,範圍效果,觸發,冰冷,持續時間
輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其在粉碎敵人時創造出寒冰漩渦。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to create an icy vortex on Shattering an enemy.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 召喚物, 範圍效果, 火焰
輔助,族裔,召喚物,範圍效果,火焰
輔助創造盟友的技能，使附近的敵人致盲並點燃。點燃的傷害基於被輔助召喚物的生命值計算。
hiddenEn: Supports skills which create Companions, causing enemies near them to be Blinded and Ignited. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 召喚物, 號令
輔助召喚物技能。被輔助的召喚物造成更多傷害，且號令技能的冷卻時間恢復率增加。
hiddenEn: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 召喚物, 號令
輔助召喚物技能。被輔助的召喚物造成更多傷害，且號令技能的冷卻時間恢復率增加。
hiddenEn: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 召喚物, 號令
輔助召喚物技能。被輔助的召喚物對號令技能的冷卻時間恢復率大幅增加。
hiddenEn: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions have significantly increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用且會造成傷害性擊中的技能。被輔助的技能會對受招架的敵人造成破甲。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Break Armour against Parried Enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助投射物技能，使投射物分裂。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Fork.

hiddenZh: 輔助在地面產生裂縫的近戰攻擊，使其產生額外的第二段裂縫，自主要的裂縫發散，且具有較低的效果範圍和傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助在地面產生裂縫的近戰攻擊，使其產生額外的第二段裂縫，自主要的裂縫發散，且具有較低的效果範圍和傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助造成傷害的技能，提高其擊中的最大物理傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which deal Damage, increasing the maximum Physical Damage of their Hits.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 物理
輔助攻擊技能。被輔助的技能擊中時也會造成切割，使敵人更容易受到流血效果。造成流血時便會移除目標的所有切割效果。
hiddenEn: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills inflict Incision on Hit, which causes Enemies to be increasingly more likely to be inflicted with Bleeding. All Incision is removed from a target on inflicting it with Bleeding.

hiddenZh: 輔助所有由自身使用的技能，使造成暴擊的機率大幅增加，但是冷卻時間延長。
hiddenEn: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to Critically Hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 冰冷, 遣散
輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其對冰凍的敵人造成更多傷害，但消耗其冰凍狀態。無法輔助消耗冰凍的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage to Frozen enemies but consume their Freeze. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 冰冷, 遣散
輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其對冰凍的敵人造成更多傷害但消耗他們的冰凍狀態，並使他們冰緩。無法輔助會消耗冰凍的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage to Frozen enemies but consume their Freeze, leaving them Chilled. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使你造成敵人感電時回復魔力。無法輔助創造召喚物，或是被圖騰或陷阱使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to regenerate mana on shocking an enemy. Cannot support skills which create Minions, or skills used by Totems or Traps.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 增益效果, 範圍效果, 觸發, 物理, 混沌, 持續時間, 植物
輔助,攻擊,增益效果,範圍效果,觸發,物理,混沌,持續時間,植物
輔助會擊中敵人的植物技能。被輔助的技能會在擊中敵人時觸發劇毒膿包。
hiddenEn: Support, Attack, Buff, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Chaos, Duration, Plant
Supports Plant Skills which Hit enemies. Supported Skills Trigger Toxic Pustule on Hitting an enemy.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 持續時間
輔助會造成非異常狀態持續傷害的法術，使其具有較短的持續時間，但對滿血敵人施加的減益效果會大幅提高造成的持續傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to have a shorter duration but deal substantially more damage over time with Debuffs inflicted against enemies on full life.

hiddenZh: 輔助在地面製造裂縫的近戰攻擊，使其犧牲傷害和攻擊速度來製造一條額外的裂縫。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create an additional fissure at the cost of damage and speed.

hiddenZh: 輔助在地面製造裂縫的近戰攻擊，使其犧牲傷害和攻擊速度來製造額外的裂縫。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional fissures at the cost of damage and speed.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的攻擊技能。使用被輔助的技能時，你會獲得較高的護甲值，而被輔助的技能的攻擊時間越長，調幅的數值就越高。無法輔助引導技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased Armour, with the increase scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的非引導技能，使其根據盛怒獲得暴擊機率，但會在你暴擊時消耗所有盛怒。
hiddenEn: Supports non-Channelling skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to gain Critical Hit chance based on Rage, but also remove all Rage upon Critically Hitting.

hiddenZh: 輔助發射投射物、非以地面為目標的技能。來自被輔助的技能的投射物會隨機分裂、連鎖或穿透。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which fire Projectiles that are not ground targeted. Projectiles from Supported Skills randomly Fork, Chain or Pierce.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 痕跡
輔助會生成痕跡的技能。拾起來自被輔助的技能所生成的痕跡時會賦予卡塔爾的回春。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that generate Remnants. Picking up Remnants from Supported Skills grants Khatal's Rejuvenation.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 攻擊, 條件
輔助由自身使用，且原先沒有使用條件的攻擊技能。被輔助的技能擁有最大暴擊率，但會分岔暴擊。
hiddenEn: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills have a maximum Critical Hit chance, but will Bifurcate Critical Hit Chance.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊, 觸發, 物理, 持續時間
輔助,攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,重擊,觸發,物理,持續時間
輔助由自身使用的重擊，使其能消耗大量符文保護來獲得符文強化。符文強化的重擊會獲得額外物理傷害的強化，並在首次擊中敵人時創造一枚符文。符文會在一段時間後以餘震形式爆發。不能輔助引導技能。
hiddenEn: Support, Attack, AoE, Melee, Slam, Trigger, Physical, Duration

Supports Slams you use yourself, allowing them to spend large amounts of Runic Ward to become Runically Boosted. Runically Boosted Slams are Empowered with extra Physical damage and create a rune the first time they hit an enemy. The rune erupts in an Aftershock after a duration. Cannot support Channelling Skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助詛咒技能。於被輔助的詛咒最後一段持續時間內，受被輔助的技能施加的詛咒影響的敵人變得平靜。
hiddenEn: Supports Curse Skills. Enemies Cursed by Supported Skills are Pacified for the final portion of the Supported Curse's duration.

hiddenZh: 輔助會創造危險的技能，使該危險無法在創造之初的3秒內被觸發。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Hazards, causing those Hazards to be unable to be triggered for 3 seconds after being created.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 物理
輔助任何技能，加強其破甲效果。以被輔助的技能達到完全破甲時，會永久增加受影響對象受到的物理傷害，直到達上限值。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger. Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills permanently increases the Physical Damage taken by those affected, up to a cap.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的傷害技能，使用時自你的召喚物汲取生命來強化技能傷害。只有在擁有生命值足夠、可以承受該汲取量的召喚物時才會生效。
hiddenEn: Supports damaging skills you use yourself, draining the life from one of your Minions on use in order to boost the skill's damage. Only takes effect if you have a Minion with enough life to drain the full amount.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的傷害技能，使用時自你的召喚物汲取生命來強化技能傷害。只有在擁有生命值足夠、可以承受該汲取量的召喚物時才會生效。
hiddenEn: Supports damaging skills you use yourself, draining the life from one of your Minions on use in order to boost the skill's damage. Only takes effect if you have a Minion with enough life to drain the full amount.

hiddenZh: 輔助召喚物技能，使其獲得 1 額外等級。不能輔助沒有等級的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Minion skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 召喚物, 近戰, 打擊
輔助,攻擊,召喚物,近戰,打擊
輔助會創造能打擊的召喚物的技能，使該召喚物的打擊近戰擴散。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Minions which Strike, causing those Minions' Strikes to have Melee Splash.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 召喚物, 近戰, 打擊
輔助,攻擊,召喚物,近戰,打擊
輔助會創造能打擊的召喚物的技能，增加它們的範圍效果並使該召喚物的打擊近戰擴散。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Minions which Strike, increasing their Area of Effect and causing those Minions' Strikes to have Melee Splash.

hiddenZh: 輔助會召喚召喚物的技能。你召喚越多不同種類的復甦召喚物，被輔助的召喚物便會造成更多傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which summon Minions. Supported Minions deal more Damage the more different kinds of Reviving Minions you have summoned.

hiddenZh: 輔助生成痕跡的技能，使這些痕跡能在更遠的距離收集。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.

hiddenZh: 輔助生成痕跡的技能，使這些痕跡能在更遠的距離收集，有一定機率生成一個額外的痕跡。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away, with a chance to create an additional Remnant.

hiddenZh: 輔助所有由自身使用的技能，使造成異常狀態的機率大幅增加，但是冷卻時間延長。
hiddenEn: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to inflict Ailments on hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 範圍效果, 詛咒
輔助詛咒，在受詛咒敵人死亡時散播其效果。
hiddenEn: Supports Curses, spreading their effects when a Cursed enemy dies.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 物理
輔助近戰攻擊技能，對流血的敵人造成更多傷害，但技能不再會對敵人造成流血。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to deal more damage against Bleeding enemies, but preventing them from inflicting Bleeding.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 重擊
輔助重擊技能。有一定機率造成餘震的被輔助的技能，其攻擊的時間越長，造成餘震的機率便會提高。
hiddenEn: Supports Slam Skills. Supported Skills that have a chance to Aftershock have increased chance to cause Aftershocks the longer their Attack time.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊
輔助,族裔,攻擊,近戰,打擊
輔助近戰打擊技能，使其能竊取所擊殺的稀有怪物身上的一條詞綴並持續一段較長的時間，但其無法對未處於貧血狀態的敵人造成傷害。無法改變召喚物使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill for a lengthy duration, while being unable to damage enemies not on low Life. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何你可使用的技能，使你在使用期間更難被擊暈。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that you can use, making you harder to Stun while using it.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的攻擊技能。被輔助的技能會穩定地獲得更多傷害，直至達到上限。此傷害加成會在你使用閃避翻滾或快行技能時重置。
hiddenEn: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的攻擊技能。被輔助的技能會穩定地獲得更多傷害，直至達到上限。此傷害加成會在你使用閃避翻滾或快行技能時重置。
hiddenEn: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何擊中敵人的技能，使其有機會在造成沉重暈眩時獲得一個耐力球。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when causing a Heavy Stun.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何擊中敵人的技能，使其有機會在造成沉重暈眩時獲得一個耐力球。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when causing a Heavy Stun.

hiddenZh: 輔助會產生圖騰的技能，使這些圖騰擁有更多生命。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.

hiddenZh: 輔助會產生圖騰的技能，使這些圖騰擁有更多生命。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.

hiddenZh: 輔助創造出一道直線牆的技能，使其改為創造出一道環形牆，但造成更少擊中傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助創造出一道直線牆的技能，使其改為創造出一道環形牆，但造成更少擊中傷害且效果範圍減少。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage and have lowered Area of Effect.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰
輔助由自身使用的近戰攻擊技能。當你越接近沉重暈眩狀態，被輔助的技能便會獲得越高的傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰
輔助由自身使用的近戰攻擊技能。當你越接近沉重暈眩狀態，被輔助的技能便會獲得越高的傷害且更能暈眩敵人。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage and are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

hiddenZh: 輔助在完美時機使用時能獲益的技能。當成功以被輔助的技能施展完美時機時，會獲得塔薩里奧的律動。每一層塔薩里奧的律動會使被輔助的技能造成更多傷害且擁有更短的完美時機空檔。 未能成功施展任何完美時機（即使是非由塔薩里奧的律動輔助的技能）時，將會移除你身上的所有塔薩里奧的律動。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Tasalio's Rhythm. Tasalio's Rhythm causes Supported Skills to deal more damage and have shorter Perfect Timing windows for each stack. Failing to execute any Perfect Timing (even with skills not supported by Tasalio's Rhythm) will remove all Tasalio's Rhythm on you.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 圖騰, 範圍效果, 觸發, 物理
輔助,族裔,圖騰,範圍效果,觸發,物理
輔助會產生圖騰的技能，使這些圖騰擁有更多生命。被輔助的技能產生的圖騰會在死亡時爆炸，依據其生命造成物理傷害。
hiddenEn: Support, Lineage, Totem, AoE, Trigger, Physical
Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life. Totems created by Supported Skills explode on death, dealing Physical damage based on their Life.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何有範圍效果的重擊，使其範圍擴大。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何有範圍效果的重擊，使其範圍擴大。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.

hiddenZh: 輔助詛咒技能，增強其力量。
hiddenEn: Supports Curse Skills, magnifying their power.

hiddenZh: 輔助投射物技能，使其發射額外的投射物，同時降低被輔助的技能的攻擊和施法速度，並減少其傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助投射物技能，使其發射額外的投射物，同時降低被輔助的技能的攻擊和施法速度，並減少其傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助產生圖騰的技能，將其生效圖騰數量限制為一個，但依據無此限制下的圖騰上限，賦予被輔助圖騰大幅增益。無法輔助召喚物使用的輔助技能。
hiddenEn: DNT Supports Skills which create Totems, limiting their active Totem count to one but granting significant benefits for supported Totems based how many allied Totems are near them. Does not support Skills used by Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助可強化特定數量其他技能的技能，使其套用至更多次技能使用。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that can Empower a specific number of other skills, causing them to apply to more skill uses.

hiddenZh: 輔助你使用或自行觸發的攻擊，使其消耗符文保護來使用，但會根據其符文保護消耗量造成額外物理和冰冷傷害，並使物理傷害貢獻至冰凍累積。不能輔助引導技能、持續技能或沒有消耗的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to cost Runic Ward to use but deal additional Physical and Cold damage based on their Runic Ward cost, in addition to causing Physical damage to Contribute to Freeze buildup. Cannot Support Channelling Skills, Sustained Skills, or Skills without a cost.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 增益效果, 持續
輔助,族裔,增益效果,持續
輔助持續性的增益效果技能，使進入你存在範圍的敵人在該技能啟動期間成為被威嚇狀態。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing enemies that enter your Presence to become Intimidated while the Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 重擊
輔助由自身使用的重擊技能。被輔助的技能獲得多個造成餘震的獨立機會，但造成更少傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Slam Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain multiple independent chances to cause Aftershocks, but deal less Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 彈藥, 投射物
輔助十字弓彈藥技能。被輔助的技能攻擊速度及弩箭裝填數量大幅增加，但造成更少傷害且具有更長的裝填時間。
hiddenEn: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Attack speed and bolt capacity, but deal less damage and have longer reload time.

hiddenZh: 輔助戰吼技能。受被輔助的技能強化的攻擊有機會在使用時不會降低被輔助的技能的強化數值。
hiddenEn: Supports Warcry Skills. Attacks Empowered by Supported Skills have a chance not to lower the Empowerment count of Supported Skills when they are used.

hiddenZh: 輔助能因完美時機而受益的技能。以被輔助的技能成功施展完美時機時，將會獲得能強化傷害的完美增益效果。但是，如果沒能施展任何完美時機（就算使用不受完美輔助的技能），將會移除你身上的所有完美效果。
hiddenEn: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Perfection, which is a powerful damage buff. However, failing to execute any Perfect Timing (even with skills not supported by Perfection) will remove all Perfection on you.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 物理, 混沌, 條件
輔助任何由自身使用的技能，被輔助的技能會引爆你身上的易爆。當你帶有一定數量的易爆時，才可使用被輔助的技能，且無法輔助已具有另一個條件的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill you use yourself, causing supported Skill to detonate Volatility that is present on you. Supported Skill can only be used while you have a certain amount of Volatility and cannot support Skills which already have another Condition.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 範圍效果, 觸發, 冰冷
輔助,範圍效果,觸發,冰冷
輔助會創造冰晶的技能。使該技能如果允許的話，則消耗一顆暴擊球並在冰晶周圍創造冰緩地面。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill that creates Ice Crystals, causing that Skill to Consume a Power Charge if possible to create Chilled Ground around the Crystal.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 持續時間
輔助會擊中敵人的技能。以被輔助的技能沉重暈眩敵人時會在持續時間內增加你的法術傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Heavy Stunning an enemy with Supported Skills increases your Spell damage for a duration.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 持續時間
輔助會擊中敵人的技能。以被輔助的技能沉重暈眩敵人時會在持續時間內增加你的法術傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Heavy Stunning an enemy with Supported Skills increases your Spell damage for a duration.

hiddenZh: 輔助可在移動期間使用的技能，使你在使用時移動較慢，但賦予更多傷害作為交換。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that can be used while moving, causing you to move slower while using them, but granting more damage in exchange.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何擊中敵人的技能，使得擊殺的敵人也會賦予更多藥劑和護符充能。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Flask and Charm charges.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，當敵人與你的距離越近，技能造成的釘身累積更高。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing any Pin buildup it inflicts to be stronger the closer the enemy is to you.

hiddenZh: 輔助詛咒技能，使其在施放後更快對敵人施加詛咒。
hiddenEn: Supports Curse skills, causing them to Curse enemies more quickly after being cast.

hiddenZh: 輔助消耗屍體的技能，使其有一定機率在生效時不摧毀屍體。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that consume Corpses, giving them a chance to take effect without destroying the Corpse.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰
輔助由自身使用的近戰攻擊技能。使用輔助技能時，一定百分比的承受傷害會補償為生命，而被輔助的技能的攻擊時間越長，調幅的百分比就越高。無法輔助引導技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, a percentage of Damage taken is Recouped as Life, with the percentage scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the Supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 攻擊, 近戰
輔助在地面製造裂縫的技能，使其以降低傷害、攻擊速度和效果範圍為代價來製造多條額外的裂縫。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create many additional fissures at the cost of damage, speed, and area of effect.

hiddenZh: 輔助會消耗屍體的技能。以被輔助的技能消耗屍體時會回復藥水充能。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that consume Corpses. Consuming Corpses with supported skills grants Flask charges.

hiddenZh: 輔助造成傷害的技能，近期使用的每一種不同元素類型的技能都會提高被輔助的技能所造成的元素傷害。不能輔助召喚物技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which deal Damage, raising Elemental Damage dealt for each Skill used Recently of a different Elemental type. Cannot support Minion Skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 召喚物, 持續
輔助會召喚持續召喚物的技能。被輔助的召喚物更加龐大、具有更多生命，且會造成更多傷害，但消耗的精魂大幅增加。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which summon Persistent Minions. Supported Minions are larger, have more Life, and deal more Damage, but cost significantly more Spirit.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 召喚物
輔助創造召喚物的技能，使那些召喚物無法造成或承受傷害。無法輔助創造無法被傷害的召喚物的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports skills which create Minions, causing those Minions to be unable to deal or take Damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 戰吼, 觸發, 物理, 持續時間
輔助,族裔,戰吼,觸發,物理,持續時間
輔助戰吼，使其以你的生命為代價，觸發扭曲契約，對其效果範圍內的敵人施加腐化之血。
hiddenEn: Support, Lineage, Warcry, Trigger, Physical, Duration
Supports Warcries, Triggering Twisted Pact  to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect., at the cost of your Life.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 觸發, 持續時間
輔助,族裔,攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,觸發,持續時間
hiddenEn: Support, Lineage, Attack, AoE, Melee, Trigger, Duration

hiddenZh: 輔助所有由自身使用的技能，使它的效果範圍大幅增加，但是冷卻時間延長。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher Area of Effect but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

hiddenZh: 輔助會產生危險的技能，使這些危險只會在創造後立即觸發，或在持續時間結束時觸發。產生的危險持續時間大幅縮短，且會造成更多傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Hazards, causing those Hazards to only be able to trigger immediately after creation or at the end of their duration. Created Hazards have significantly lowered duration, and deal more damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助需要達成特定條件才能使用的技能。被輔助的技能在達到特定條件後可額外使用一次，但達成條件的難度將會提高。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which require some Condition to be met for use. Supported Skills can be used an additional time after their Condition has been met, but meeting that Condition is harder.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何具持續時間的技能，延長其持續時間。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration longer.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何具持續時間的技能，延長其持續時間。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration longer.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何有持續時間的技能，使其持續時間大幅延長，但會附加冷卻時間。無法輔助已具有冷卻時間的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration significantly longer while applying a cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 攻擊, 近戰, 條件
輔助,族裔,攻擊,近戰,條件
輔助近戰攻擊技能。當你以其他近戰攻擊成功打擊敵人時，被輔助的技能獲得連擊。使用被輔助的技能時即消耗其連擊，使用時擁有的連擊數越多，範圍效果就越大。不能輔助已經獲得連擊的技能。無法修改由召喚物使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills expend their Combo when used, gaining more area of effect the higher Combo they had. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 戰吼
輔助戰吼技能，使其摧毀冰晶和寒冰碎片。被輔助的技能若摧毀足夠冰晶和寒冰碎片，則會強化額外攻擊次數。
hiddenEn: Supports Warcries, causing them to destroy Ice Crystals and Ice Fragments. Supported Skills empower additional Attacks if they destroy enough Ice Crystals and Ice Fragments.

hiddenZh: 輔助能對敵人造成曝曬的技能，提高所施加曝曬的效果。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which apply Exposure to Enemies, increasing the effect of applied Exposure.

hiddenZh: 輔助攻擊，使其增加命中值。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy.

hiddenZh: 輔助攻擊，使其增加命中且必定命中滿血敵人。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy, and never miss against Enemies on full Life.

hiddenZh: 輔助會製造圖騰的技能。被輔助的技能所製造的圖騰擁有額外的元素抗性。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.

hiddenZh: 輔助會製造圖騰的技能。被輔助的技能所製造的圖騰擁有額外的元素抗性。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，提升其感電效果但也會反射給你。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making its Shocks more effective but reflecting them back to you as well.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 投射物, 觸發, 閃電, 持續時間
輔助,投射物,觸發,閃電,持續時間
輔助會生成能量球的技能。以被輔助的技能生成能量球時，強化你的某些攻擊並使其在使用時觸發電球投射物。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which generate Charges. When generating Power Charge with Supported Skills, Empower some of your Attacks to Trigger Spark Projectiles on use.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 投射物, 觸發, 閃電, 持續時間
輔助,投射物,觸發,閃電,持續時間
輔助生成能量球的技能。當以被輔助的技能生成暴擊球時， 強化你的某些攻擊並在使用時觸發電球投射物。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which generate Charges. When generating Power Charge with Supported Skills, Empower some of your Attacks to Trigger Spark Projectiles on use.

hiddenZh: 輔助所有會製造投射物的技能，讓這些投射物在擊中地形時，有機會造成連鎖。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.

hiddenZh: 輔助所有會製造投射物的技能，讓這些投射物在擊中地形時，有機會造成連鎖。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.

hiddenZh: 輔助所有會製造投射物的技能，消耗額外的投射物，讓這些投射物在擊中地形時造成連鎖，並使其必定穿透。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, causing those Projectiles to Chain when impacting terrain, at the cost of any additional Projectiles, as well as causing them to always Pierce.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 彈藥, 投射物
輔助十字弓彈藥技能，在射擊時有機率不消耗弩箭。
hiddenEn: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 彈藥, 投射物
輔助十字弓彈藥技能，在射擊時有機率不消耗弩箭。
hiddenEn: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 彈藥, 投射物
輔助十字弓彈藥技能，以裝填速度為代價，在射擊時有機率不消耗弩箭。
hiddenEn: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing, at the cost of Reload speed.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 召喚物, 火焰
輔助創造出召喚物的技能，使其貧血時發生劇烈爆炸。
hiddenEn: Supports skills which create Minions, causing them to violently explode when reduced to Low Life.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 法術, 範圍效果, 觸發, 混沌, 詛咒
輔助,族裔,法術,範圍效果,觸發,混沌,詛咒
輔助詛咒技能。被輔助的技能會創造一個區域，詛咒其中的敵人，並在該區域生成巫蟾。巫蟾會跳向靠近的敵人，並更積極地尋找被詛咒的敵人。當牠們以跳躍擊中敵人時，黑暗業報會被觸發，使巫蟾猛烈爆炸。
hiddenEn: Support, Lineage, Spell, AoE, Trigger, Chaos, Curse

Supports Curse Skills. Supported Skills create an area which Curses Enemies within it, and spawns Witchtoads in that area. Witchtoads leap at enemies that get close, and seek out Cursed enemies with higher aggression. Dark Consequences will be Triggered when they hit enemies with their leap, violently exploding the Witchtoad.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 鬥旗, 族裔
輔助鬥旗技能，使其使用的榮耀需求大量減少
hiddenEn: Supports Banner Skills, causing them to require significantly less Glory to use.

hiddenZh: 輔助創造可受到傷害之盟友的技能。由被輔助的技能產生的召喚物會承受你原本要承受的一部分擊中傷害，但其最大生命減少。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life.

hiddenZh: 輔助具冷卻時間的技能，使其在冷卻時間內可額外使用。
無法輔助主要寶石、立即施放或觸發的技能，或是改變召喚物技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助具冷卻時間的技能，使其在冷卻時間內可額外使用。
無法輔助主要寶石、立即施放或觸發的技能，或是改變召喚物技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助具冷卻時間的技能，使其在該次冷卻時間內可額外使用且進入冷卻時間時可恢復生命。
無法輔助主要寶石、立即施放或觸發的技能，或是改變召喚物技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown and causing them to recover your Life when a Skill is used and goes on cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其更容易施加感電。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Shock.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 範圍效果, 閃電
輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使你在感電一名敵人時，有一定機率同時感電附近的敵人。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 範圍效果, 閃電
輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，給予其一個在感電一名敵人時有機率感電周遭的其他敵人。總是感電濕透的敵人
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy. Always Shocks enemies which are Drenched.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用或觸發、會造成傷害性擊中的技能。若你在施加被輔助的技能時有異常狀態，輔助技能便會造成更強的對應異常狀態，同時移除其對你造成的異常狀態。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills you use or Trigger yourself, which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills inflict more powerful Ailments if you are afflicted with those Ailments when you inflict them, while also removing from you any Ailment that they inflict.

hiddenZh: 輔助戰吼技能，使用時會根據納入計算的怪物強度賦予你盛怒。
hiddenEn: Supports Warcry skills, causing them to grant you Rage on use depending on counted monster Power.

hiddenZh: 輔助會產生圖騰的技能，使這些技能更加快速地放置圖騰。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.

hiddenZh: 輔助會產生圖騰的技能，使這些技能更加快速地放置圖騰。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.

hiddenZh: 輔助會產生圖騰的技能，使這些技能更加快速地放置圖騰。被輔助的技能所產生的圖騰會增加攻擊和施法速度。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly. Totems created by Supported Skills have increased Attack and Cast Speed.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使得擊殺的敵人也會賦予更多藥劑和護符充能。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Flask and Charm charges.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 條件
輔助由自身使用，且原先沒有使用條件的攻擊技能。被輔助的技能只能在你移動一定距離後使用，但有大幅增加的技能速度。無法輔助具有冷卻時間的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills can only be used after you have moved a certain distance, but have massively increased Skill Speed. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰
輔助近戰攻擊技能。當你越接近沉重暈眩狀態，被輔助的技能使敵人暈眩的能力越強。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其有機會在完全破壞敵人的護甲時獲得一個耐力球。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when it Fully Breaks an enemy's Armour.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 冰冷, 混沌
輔助會造成傷害型擊中的技能，賦予其額外混沌傷害，並使混沌傷害貢獻至冰凍累積。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Freeze Buildup.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 法術, 範圍效果
輔助,族裔,法術,範圍效果
輔助由你自身施放的可爆發法術，在你格擋時封印它們。使用時破除封印，使每個法術迴響。無法輔助具有冷卻時間或已獲得封印的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Cascadable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them when you Block, The Seals are broken when used, each making the Spell Echo. Cannot support skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

hiddenZh: 輔助發射擲彈的技能，使發射的擲彈有機率再次啟動，但是延長其冷卻時間。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which fire Grenades, giving fired Grenades a chance to activate again, but lengthening their cooldowns.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用或由你觸發的任何技能。被輔助的技能無法透過任何方式消耗能量球或元素灌注。無法輔助需要能量球或元素灌注才能使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill you use or Trigger yourself. Supported Skills cannot consume Charges or Infusion by any means. Cannot Support Skills which require Charges or Infusion to be used.

hiddenZh: 輔助投射物技能，使投射物的行進更為快速。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster.

hiddenZh: 輔助投射物技能，使投射物的行進更為快速，並賦予其一定機率穿透敵人。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and granting them a chance to Pierce Enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助投射物技能，使投射物的行進更為快速，並使投射物速度的增減也套用於傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and causing increases and reductions to Projectile speed to also apply to Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助投射物技能，使投射物的行進更為緩慢。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.

hiddenZh: 輔助投射物技能，使投射物的行進更為緩慢。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助鬥旗技能，使受到其創造之光環影響的人獲得折射護板，這是一種增益效果，會賦予偏斜值，並使護甲值部分套用至元素擊中傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which grants Deflection Rating and causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助鬥旗技能，使受到其創造之光環影響的人獲得折射護板，這是一種增益效果，會賦予偏斜值，並使護甲值部分套用至元素擊中傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which grants Deflection Rating and causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助旗幟技能，使範圍內敵人得到折射分解，該減益效果或降低元素抗性。
hiddenEn: Supports Banner Skills, causing Enemies within their area to gain Refractive Dissolution, a Debuff which lowers Elemental Resistances.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 重擊
輔助由自身使用的重擊技能，每隔數秒提供強力的先祖強化。
hiddenEn: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 重擊
輔助由自身使用的重擊技能，每隔數秒提供強力的先祖強化。
hiddenEn: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 重擊
輔助由自身使用的重擊技能，每隔數秒提供非常強力的先祖強化。
hiddenEn: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a very powerful Ancestral Boost infrequently.

hiddenZh: 輔助會生成地面的技能，使生成的地面持續時間大幅延長。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer.

hiddenZh: 輔助會生成地面的技能，使生成的地面持續時間大幅延長，且只會在其持續時間結束後消失。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer and only end when their duration expires.

hiddenZh: 輔助會生成地面的技能，使生成的地面持續時間大幅延長，同時降低受其影響敵人的冷卻時間恢復率。被輔助的技能生成的地面只有在其持續時間結束後才會消失。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer as well as lowering the Cooldown Recovery Speed of affected Enemies. Ground Surfaces from Supported Skills only end when their duration expires.

hiddenZh: 輔助能製造地面的技能，讓那些地面可以存留更久。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those surfaces to last longer.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人或造成感電的技能，使其感電的頻率較低，但持續時間更長。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies or inflicts Shock, causing its Shocks to be inflicted less often but last longer.

hiddenZh: 輔助風暴技能，使其出現在使用者的位置，並朝目標位置移動。
hiddenEn: Supports Storm skills, causing them to appear at the user's location and move towards the target location.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 混沌
輔助造成擊中傷害的法術技能。使用被輔助的法術時會令你犧牲一部分生命，以獲得額外的混沌傷害。不能輔助持續技能、召喚物技能或觸發技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Spell Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Using supported Spells will cause you to Sacrifice a portion of your Life on use, gaining extra Chaos Damage in exchange. Does not support Persistent Skills, Minion Skills, or Triggered Skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 物理, 持續時間, 痕跡
輔助,攻擊,近戰,物理,持續時間,痕跡
輔助由自身使用或由你觸發的近戰攻擊技能。被輔助的技能對流血敵人造成最後一擊時，會產生一個鮮血痕跡。拾起鮮血痕跡後會在短時間內提高你的生命回復率。
hiddenEn: Support, Attack, Melee, Physical, Duration, Remnant

Supports Melee Attack Skills you use or Trigger yourself. Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies create a Blood Remnant. Blood Remnants increase your Life regeneration rate for a short while after being collected.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 物理
輔助由自身使用或由你觸發的近戰攻擊。被輔助的技能對流血敵人造成最後一擊而觸發擊殺效果時，有機會發生兩次。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attacks you use or Trigger yourself. On-Kill effects caused by Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies have a chance to occur twice.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊
輔助會在一系列打擊後進行最終打擊的攻擊，使最終打擊基於一部分造成的攻擊傷害施加護甲破壞。
hiddenEn: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to Break Armour based on a portion of Attack damage dealt.

hiddenZh: 輔助生成投射物的技能。若你在過去八秒內以近戰擊中，被輔助的技能的投射物傷害便會提高，但自身不會造成近戰傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助生成投射物的技能。若你在過去八秒內以近戰擊中，被輔助的技能的投射物傷害便會提高，但自身不會造成近戰傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助生成投射物的技能。若你在過去兩秒內以近戰擊中，被輔助的技能的投射物傷害便會提高，但自身不會造成近戰傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助攻擊技能，使其擊中稀有和傳奇敵人時造成撲殺效果。
hiddenEn: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to Cull Rare and Unique Enemies on Hit.

hiddenZh: 輔助攻擊技能，使其撲殺擊中的稀有和傳奇敵人，並增加其撲殺敵人的門檻。
hiddenEn: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to Cull Rare and Unique Enemies on Hit, and increasing the threshold at which they will Cull Enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其擊退敵人。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Knock Back enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 範圍效果
輔助由你自身施放的法術，使其隨時間獲得封印。施放時會破除封印，增加效果範圍。無法輔助引導技能、具有冷卻時間的技能，或已會獲得封印的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when cast, increasing area of effect. Cannot support Channelling Skills or Skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何擊中敵人的攻擊，將敵人冰凍時，對附近敵人造成冰緩。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that hits enemies, causing them to Chill enemies near enemies they Freeze.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其對護甲遭破壞的敵人造成更多傷害，但不會對自身造成破壞護甲。無法輔助消耗破壞護甲的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more Damage against enemies with Broken Armour but preventing them from Breaking Armour themselves. Cannot support skills that Consume Broken Armour.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何技能，使其使用消耗減少。無法輔助保留精魂的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill, making it cost less to use. Cannot support skills which reserve Spirit.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何技能，使其使用消耗減少。無法輔助保留精魂的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill, making it cost less to use. Cannot support skills which reserve Spirit.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊
輔助打擊技能，使其能從擊殺的稀有怪物身上偷取 1 個詞綴。
hiddenEn: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊
輔助打擊技能，使其能從擊殺的稀有怪物身上偷取 2 個詞綴。
hiddenEn: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal two Modifiers from Rare monsters they kill.

hiddenZh: 輔助會舉起盾牌的技能，格擋時使你非盾牌的近戰技能造成更多傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that Raise your Shield causing your other melee skills to deal more damage if you block.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 物理
輔助擊中敵人的盾牌技能，使那些擊中對目標造成壓碎，此外當對被壓碎的目標造成任何物理傷害擊中時，同時會破壞護甲。
hiddenEn: Supports Shield Skills that Hit, causing those Hits to Crush their targets, and Physical Hits against those targets while Crushed to Break their Armour.

hiddenZh: 輔助投射物技能，使其以環狀方式發射投射物，但傷害較低。無法輔助從上方降下投射物的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire Projectiles in a circle. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above.

hiddenZh: 輔助投射物技能，使他們以環狀方式發射額外投射物，以降低傷害和新增一個冷卻作為代價。無法輔助從上方降下投射物的技能。無法輔助原先已有冷卻時間的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire extra Projectiles in a circle, at the cost of Damage and gaining a cooldown. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above. Cannot Support Skills which already have a cooldown.

hiddenZh: 輔助在經過一段時間後引爆的技能，縮短其引爆前時間。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, shortening the time before Detonation.

hiddenZh: 輔助在經過一段時間後引爆的技能，大幅縮短其引爆前的時間，但使其傷害減少。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, massively shortening the time before Detonation at the cost of Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 物理, 混沌
輔助由自身使用、可造成傷害性擊中的技能。被輔助的技能暴擊時會賦予易爆。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills grant Volatility on Critical Hit.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 物理, 冰冷
輔助會擊中敵人的技能。以被輔助的技能擊中冰凍敵人時會使對其造成的物理傷害在冰凍期間內破壞護甲。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills which Freeze enemies cause Physical damage against them to Break their Armour while they remain Frozen.

hiddenZh: 輔助新星技能，讓這些技能在使用時，作用於目標位置，而非以你為中心。
hiddenEn: Supports Nova Skills, causing those Skills to take place at the targeted location when used instead of around you.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其暈眩累積更快。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun more quickly.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其暈眩累積更快。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun more quickly.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其暈眩累積大幅加快但減少傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun significantly more quickly, at the cost of Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 戰吼, 持續時間
輔助戰吼。被輔助的技能擊中敵人時施加 曝曬。
hiddenEn: Supports Warcries. Supported Skills apply Exposure on Hitting enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 重擊, 火焰
輔助,攻擊,近戰,重擊,火焰
輔助由自身使用的重擊技能。被輔助的技能擊中點燃和完全破甲的敵人時，會被視為粉碎重擊。使用被輔助的技能擊中點燃和完全破甲的敵人並造成沉重暈眩時，會對其施加威嚇。
hiddenEn: Supports Slam Skills you use yourself. Hits from Supported Skills are considered Crushing Blows against Enemies which are both Ignited and Fully Armour Broken. Hits with Supported Skills that Heavily Stun Ignited and Fully Armour Broken Enemies will Intimidate them.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 範圍效果, 觸發, 混沌
輔助,法術,範圍效果,觸發,混沌
輔助你自己施放的詛咒技能，使得受詛咒的敵人在詛咒結束時觸發厄運枯萎。
hiddenEn: Supports Curse skills you cast yourself, causing them to trigger Doom Blast on Cursed enemies when the Curse expires.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 召喚物, 混沌
輔助可命令的召喚物，使你與被輔助的召喚物在你號令他們時獲得不潔之力。
hiddenEn: Supports Commandable Minions causing you and the Supported Minion to gain Unholy Might when you Command them.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 攻擊, 近戰
輔助由自身使用的近戰攻擊，使其擊中時賦予一定比例的最大盛怒。同時會使被輔助的近戰攻擊根據盛怒量增加攻擊速度，並使你在使用被輔助的技能時失去一定比例的最大生命。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself, causing them to attack faster the more Rage you have and grant Rage on Hit, but also making you lose Life based on your Rage when using them.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續增益效果技能，使你在被輔助的技能啟動期間，於貧血時造成的攻擊傷害增加。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Attack Damage while on Low Life while the Supported Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續增益效果技能，使你在被輔助的技能啟動期間，於貧血時造成的攻擊傷害增加。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Attack Damage while on Low Life while the Supported Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助法術技能。你的魔力高於最大魔力的 90% 時使用，被輔助的技能會造成更多傷害。不能修改由召喚物使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage while you are above 90% of your Maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助法術技能。 使用時若你的魔力高於最大魔力的 90%，被輔助的技能會造成更多傷害。無法修改由召喚物使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills have increased Mana cost Efficiency and deal more damage while you are above 90% of your maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何造成傷害的技能，使其造成更多非異常狀態的持續傷害，但縮短其持續時間。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何造成傷害的技能，使其造成更多非異常狀態的持續傷害，但縮短其持續時間。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何造成傷害的技能，使效果持續時間少於一秒的技能造成更多非異常狀態的持續傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing effects with a duration of one second or less to deal more non-Ailment damage over time.

hiddenZh: 輔助會擊中敵人的技能。被輔助的技能在攻擊受禁錮的敵人時，有更高的暴擊機率。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies. Supported Skills gain increased chance to Critically Hit against Immobilised Enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助移動時可使用的技能，讓你在使用時移動得更快。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that can be used while moving, allowing you to move faster while using them.

hiddenZh: 輔助在完美時機釋放將擁有特殊效果的引導技能，使其在完美時機釋放時造成更多傷害，但縮短完美時機的空檔。
hiddenEn: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.

hiddenZh: 輔助在完美時機釋放將擁有特殊效果的引導技能，使其在完美時機釋放時造成更多傷害並賦予完美偏斜，但縮短完美時機的空檔。
hiddenEn: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage and grant Perfect Deflection if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 法術, 範圍效果, 觸發, 持續時間
輔助,族裔,法術,範圍效果,觸發,持續時間
輔助你所施放的非立即法術。被輔助的法術會觸發破碎仿身，創造一個會在你擁有足夠數量時施放該法術的破碎複製體。
hiddenEn: Support, Lineage, Spell, AoE, Trigger, Duration
Supports non-instant Spells you cast yourself. Supported Spells will Trigger Fragment Self, creating a Fractured Mimic which will cast that Spell if you get enough of them.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 法術
輔助會擊中敵人的技能，使其的魔力偷取基於元素傷害而不是物理傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which Hit enemies, causing their Mana Leech to recover based on Elemental damage instead of Physical damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 印記, 物理
輔助印記技能。受被輔助印記影響的敵人會因為受到物理傷害而發生護甲破壞。
hiddenEn: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 印記, 物理
輔助印記技能。受到被輔助的印記影響的敵人會根據承受的物理傷害被護甲破壞。
hiddenEn: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 召喚物, 持續
輔助可生成持續召喚物的技能。被輔助的召喚物在死亡時，會為附近的友方召喚物恢復生命，並為這些召喚物移除異常狀態。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Persistent Minions. Supported Minions will restore Life to nearby Allied Minions on death, as well as removing Ailments from those Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助攻擊，反覆使用該技能時能更有效地擊暈敵人。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, causing repeated uses to be more effective at Stunning enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助會創造圖騰的技能，使你無法同時擁有多於一根啟動中的圖騰，但該圖騰使用攻擊或法術後自身會散裂成較小的分身，而各自造成更少圖騰傷害。散裂出的每個圖騰仍可再度散裂，直到達到上限。無法輔助由召喚物施放的技能。同一時間僅能有一根散裂的圖騰。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.

hiddenZh: 輔助會創造圖騰的技能，使你無法擁有超過一根該圖騰，但是會使但該圖騰使用攻擊或法術後分裂成自身更小的版本，但每一根圖騰擁有更少傷害。分裂後的圖騰可以再次分裂，直到達到上限。無法輔助召喚物使用的技能。同一時間僅能有一根分裂的圖騰。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.

hiddenZh: 輔助會擊中敵人的技能。被輔助的技能擊中沉重暈眩的敵人時，加劇其身上的流血。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that Hit Enemies. Supported skills Aggravate Bleeding on Hitting Heavily Stunned Enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助可強化本身以外技能的技能，使強化的技能將敵人撲殺。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that can Empower skills other than themselves, causing skills they Empower to Cull enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 閃電, 持續時間
輔助,攻擊,閃電,持續時間
輔助由自身施放且會擊中敵人的技能。以被輔助的技能撲殺一名感電的敵人時會注能自身，使你一段時間內的所有攻擊附加閃電傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage for a short time.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 閃電, 持續時間
輔助,攻擊,閃電,持續時間
輔助由自身施放且會擊中敵人的技能。以被輔助的技能撲殺一名感電的敵人時會注能自身，使你一段時間內的所有攻擊附加閃電傷害並且增加感電機率。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage and grants an increased chance to Shock for a short time.

hiddenZh: 輔助可對敵人造成傷害的技能。被輔助的技能的非傷害型異常狀態的持續傷害影響的敵人，會有較低的生命回復速度。只會施加最強的此一減益效果。無法輔助召喚物使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies. Enemies affected by Damage over time from Supported Skills which was not caused by a Damaging Ailment have reduced Life regeneration rate. Only the strongest instance of this Debuff will apply. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何由由自身使用的傷害技能，若在使用技能時移動足夠的距離，則技能會造成更多傷害。傳送不會被計入移動的距離。
hiddenEn: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal more damage if you move a sufficient distance while using the skill. Teleportation does not count towards the distance travelled.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的法術技能。使用被輔助的技能時，一定百分比的承受傷害會補償為魔力，而被輔助的技能的施法時間越長，調幅的百分比就越高。無法輔助引導技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Spell Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, a percentage of Damage taken is Recouped as Mana, with the percentage scaling higher the longer the Cast time of the Supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助你自己施放的詛咒技能。被輔助的技能在使用時消耗暴擊球，在消耗後獲得大量詛咒持續時間。無法輔助會消耗狂怒球的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Curse Skills you cast yourself. Supported Skills will consume Power Charges on use, gaining significant Curse duration if they do. Cannot Support Skills which consume Power Charges.

hiddenZh: 輔助使用時消耗暴擊球、狂怒球或耐力球的技能，使其有一定機率不消耗能量球，卻能獲得消耗時的增益效果。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that consume Power, Frenzy or Endurance Charges on use, giving them a chance not to remove each Charge while still gaining the benefits of consuming them.

hiddenZh: 輔助印記技能，使其在啟動時不會被消耗。
hiddenEn: Supports Mark Skills, causing them to not be Consumed the first time they are Activated.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其點燃的頻率較低，但持續時間更長。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to be inflicted less often but last longer.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其受到的點燃持續時間延長。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to last longer.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其造成暴擊時刷新點燃效果。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to refresh Ignites on Critical Hit.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 戰吼, 觸發, 物理, 持續時間
輔助,戰吼,觸發,物理,持續時間
輔助戰吼，使其觸發腐化戰吼，對其效果範圍內的敵人施加腐化之血。
hiddenEn: Supports Warcries, Triggering Corrupted Cry to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 戰吼, 觸發, 物理, 持續時間
輔助,戰吼,觸發,物理,持續時間
輔助戰吼，使其觸發腐化戰吼，對其效果範圍內的敵人施加腐化之血。
hiddenEn: Supports Warcries, Triggering Corrupted Cry to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.

hiddenZh: 輔助印記技能，使你的攻擊擊中被該技能標記的敵人時偷取魔力。
hiddenEn: Supports Mark Skills, causing enemies they Mark to Leech Mana to you when you Hit them with Attacks.

hiddenZh: 輔助印記技能，使你的攻擊擊中被該技能標記的敵人時偷取生命和魔力。
hiddenEn: Supports Mark Skills, causing enemies they Mark to Leech Life and Mana to you when you Hit them with Attacks.

hiddenZh: 輔助造成非異常狀態持續傷害的法術，使其在對敵人施加持續傷害的減益效果時，消耗敵人身上的異常狀態並大幅提高造成的傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to consume Ailments on enemies it applies damage over time Debuffs to in order to deal substantially more damage over time.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 範圍效果
輔助擊中目標且具有範圍效果的技能，擴大其影響範圍，並使其對孤立目標造成更多擊中傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports skills which Hit targets and have an area of effect, increasing the affected area and causing it to Hit Isolated targets harder.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 物理
輔助近戰攻擊技能，增強其物理傷害，但犧牲攻擊速度。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attacks, boosting their Physical damage at the cost of Attack Speed.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何由自身使用的傷害技能，使其造成的傷害大幅提升，但冷卻時間延長。無法輔助已具有冷卻時間的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal significantly more damage but gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續性的增益效果技能，使你失去符文保護並根據失去的符文保護量治療附近的友方。治療量會在生命未滿的友方之間均分。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to lose Runic Ward and heal nearby allies based on the Ward lost. Healing done is split between allies who are not on full Life.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 範圍效果
輔助由你自身施放的可爆發法術。被輔助的法術會迴響。
hiddenEn: Supports Cascadable Spells you use yourself. Supported Spells Echo.

hiddenZh: 輔助持續增益技能，使其賦予的增益效果更高。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, making the Buff they grant more powerful.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續性的增益技能，使你在該技能啟動期間，可以獲得更多的生命回復。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續增益效果的技能，使你在該技能啟動期間，可以獲得更多的生命回復。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何技能，使其一部分的魔力消耗轉換為消耗生命。無法輔助保留精魂的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill, turning its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 召喚物, 觸發, 閃電, 持續時間
輔助,召喚物,觸發,閃電,持續時間
輔助會造成傷害性擊中的技能。被輔助的技能造成閃電傷害時會創造活躍閃電召喚物，它們會匯集並以活躍電能連鎖攻擊鎖定附近的敵人。敵人不會直接接觸這些召喚物，且可以穿過它們。無法改變召喚物使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Living Lightning Minions are created when dealing Lightning damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with Chaining Attacks. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 召喚物, 觸發, 閃電, 持續時間
輔助,召喚物,觸發,閃電,持續時間
輔助會造成傷害性擊中的技能。被輔助的技能造成閃電傷害時會創造活躍閃電召喚物，它們會匯集並以活躍電能連鎖攻擊鎖定附近的敵人。敵人不會直接接觸這些召喚物，且可以穿過它們。無法改變召喚物使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Living Lightning Minions are created when dealing Lightning damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with Chaining Attacks. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助需要連擊的技能。被輔助的技能若沒有獲得連擊，會在較長一段時間後失去連擊。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which require Combo to use. Supported Skills lose their Combo stacks after a longer delay spent not gaining any Combo.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，有一定機率造成流血。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to inflict Bleeding.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，有一定機率造成流血。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to inflict Bleeding.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其造成流血。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Bleeding.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何可擊中敵人的技能，使其對流血敵人造成更多近戰物理傷害，但本身無法造成流血。被輔助的技能也會在擊中時造成切割。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Melee Physical Damage to Bleeding Enemies, but be unable to inflict Bleeding itself. Supported Skills also inflict Incision on Hit.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 物理
輔助攻擊技能。被輔助的技能有更大的機率在擊中滿血的敵人時造成流血效果。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks. Supported Skills are far more likely to inflict Bleeding on Hitting full Life Enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 變形, 增益效果
輔助,族裔,變形,增益效果
輔助變形技能，使其在使你變形時短暫賦予海爾賓姆的沉著一段時間。
在增益效果持續時間結束前變形成其他型態會移除此效果。
hiddenEn: Supports Shapeshifting Skills, causing them to grant Helbrym's Composure for a brief duration when they cause you to Shapeshift. Shapeshifting into a different form before the Buff expires causes it to be removed without effect.

hiddenZh: 輔助會獲得疊層或封印的技能。被輔助的技能的最大疊層或封印數量較低，但具有無法低於的最低疊層或封印數量。
hiddenEn: DNT-UNUSED Supports Skills which gain Stages or Seals. Supported Skills have lower Maximum Stage or Seal count, but have a Minimum Stage or Seal count they cannot fall below.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使施加的點燃造成更多傷害，但技能會增加符文保護消耗。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but the skill to gain a Runic Ward cost.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其造成的冰凍持續時間延長。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Freeze it inflicts to last longer.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其造成更少傷害，但造成更強力的流血。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Bleeding.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其造成更少傷害，但造成更強效的流血。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Bleeding.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 物理, 混沌
輔助會造成傷害性擊中的技能。由這些擊中造成的流血對中毒敵人具有更強的效果，且由被輔助的技能對流血敵人造成的中毒具有更強的效果。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Bleeding inflicted by those Hits is more effective against Poisoned Enemies, and Poison inflicted by Supported Skills is more effective against Bleeding Enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 混沌
輔助可造成非異常狀態混沌持續傷害的法術。因輔助技能造成的減益效果而受到持續傷害的敵人，會承受任何來源的混沌傷害擊中所累積的冰凍。無法輔助召喚物使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment Chaos damage over time. Enemies taking damage over time from Debuffs caused by supported skills will suffer Freeze build up from Chaos damage Hits from any source. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何造成傷害的技能，使其獲得混沌傷害，但同時減少其他類型的傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Chaos Damage but deal less Damage of other Types.

hiddenZh: 輔助混沌技能，使其獲得 1 額外等級。不能輔助沒有等級的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Chaos skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續性的增益技能，使你在該技能啟動期間，可以獲得更多的魔力回復。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Mana Regeneration while the Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續性的增益技能，使你在該技能啟動期間，可以獲得更多的魔力回復。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Mana Regeneration while the Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續增益效果技能，使你在被輔助的技能啟動期間，於魔力未滿時你的召喚物造成的傷害增加。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 召喚物, 持續
輔助召喚盟友的技能，使其極大，並根據你自身的閃避和偏斜獲得相應加成。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which summon Companions causing them to be Gigantic and gain Evasion and Deflection based on your own.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續增益效果技能，使被輔助的技能啟動期間施加在你身上的冰凍持續時間縮短。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Freeze applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助創造出一道直線牆的技能，使其改為沿著裂縫創造出一道牆。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to instead be created along a fissure.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的技能。若是可能，在使用被輔助的技能時會消耗一顆暴擊球，使造成暴擊的機率大幅提高。被輔助的技能不能產生暴擊球。無法輔助會消耗暴擊球的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a Power Charge on use if possible, and will be much more likely to Critically Hit if they do. Supported Skills cannot generate Power Charges. Cannot Support Skills which consume Power Charges.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 戰吼
輔助自身使用的攻擊和戰吼。被輔助的技能獲得榮耀消耗需求，且在你消耗生命施放技能時累積榮耀。被輔助的技能造成更多傷害，且顯著
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Supported Skills gain a Glory requirement, and build Glory when you spend Life on Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage and have significantly

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 法術, 範圍效果
輔助,族裔,法術,範圍效果
輔助由你自身施放的可爆發法術。被輔助的法術會迴響三次，但被輔助的技能會增加一小段冷卻時間。無法輔助已有冷卻時間的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Cascadable Spells you cast yourself. Supported Spells Echo thrice, but are given a Cooldown. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown.

hiddenZh: 輔助由你自身施放的可重複法術，使其隨時間獲得封印，並給予其適中的冷卻時間。施放時會破除封印，每個封印都會使該法術重複。無法輔助已具有冷卻時間或會獲得封印的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Repeatable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time and giving them a moderate Cooldown. The Seals are broken when cast, each causing the Spell to Repeat. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown or gain seals.

hiddenZh: 輔助擊中敵人時可造成傷害的技能，使被輔助的技能的所有傷害獲得來源改為被視為獲得額外冰冷傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies with Hits, causing all sources of Damage Gained to instead be treated as Damage Gained as extra Cold for Supported Skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助戰吼，使其消耗盛怒來略過平常的冷卻時間。
hiddenEn: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.

hiddenZh: 輔助戰吼，使其消耗盛怒來略過平常的冷卻時間。
hiddenEn: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 打擊, 投射物, 觸發, 火焰
輔助,攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,打擊,投射物,觸發,火焰
輔助由自身使用的近戰打擊技能。被輔助的技能擊中點燃的敵人時會觸發火山迸發。
hiddenEn: Support, Attack, AoE, Melee, Strike, Projectile, Trigger, Fire
Supports Melee Strike Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills trigger Volcanic Eruption on Hit against Ignited Enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 範圍效果, 觸發, 火焰
輔助,範圍效果,觸發,火焰
輔助你自己所使用、任何可擊中並造成傷害的技能。被輔助的技能會在擊中時消耗點燃來產生火柱，但本身不會造成點燃。無法輔助已會消耗點燃的技能，且無法改變召喚物技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Ignite on Hit to create pillars of flame, but cannot themselves inflict Ignite. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Ignite, and does not modify the Skills of Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何造成傷害的技能，使其獲得火焰傷害，但造成更少冰冷和閃電傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Fire Damage but deal less Cold and Lightning Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助火焰技能，使其獲得 1 額外等級。不能輔助沒有等級的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Fire skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 火焰, 持續時間
輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其點燃時造成曝曬。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when Igniting.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何可擊中敵人的技能，使擊中穿透敵人火焰抗性。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Fire resistance.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使擊中無視敵人的火焰抗性。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits ignore enemy Fire resistance.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 範圍效果, 觸發, 火焰
輔助,法術,範圍效果,觸發,火焰
輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使受其點燃的敵人有一定機率在死亡時爆炸。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it Ignites to have a chance to explode on death.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 觸發, 火焰
輔助,攻擊,範圍效果,觸發,火焰
輔助會擊中敵人的疾風技能。被輔助的技能擊中被點燃的敵人時會在其身後觸發一個錐形的火焰爆炸。
hiddenEn: Supports Wind Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against Ignited enemies Trigger a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 觸發, 火焰
輔助,攻擊,範圍效果,觸發,火焰
輔助會擊中敵人的疾風技能。被輔助的技能擊中點燃的敵人時會在它們身後觸發一陣錐形的火焰爆炸，並將原先敵人的點燃擴散至被爆炸擊中的其餘敵人。
hiddenEn: Supports Wind Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against Ignited enemies Trigger a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them. The explosion Spreads the initial enemy's Ignite to other enemies Hit.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 投射物, 火焰
輔助可發射投射物的技能。最初由被輔助的技能生成的投射物必定會穿透點燃的敵人，但被輔助的技能本身不會造成點燃。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Initial Projectile created by Supported Skills will always Pierce Ignited Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Ignite themselves.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 閃電, 火焰
輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能。受到被輔助的技能感電的敵人會同時承受一部分的點燃傷害為閃電與火焰傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies. Enemies Shocked by Supported Skills take a percentage of damage from Ignite as Lightning damage as well as Fire damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 物理, 混沌
輔助會造成傷害型擊中的技能，賦予其額外混沌傷害，並使混沌傷害可以破甲。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Break Armour.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 持續時間
輔助具有冷卻時間的技能，使其使用時獲得滿溢聖杯。被輔助的技能在你的生命藥劑效果期間造成更多傷害，並在你的魔力藥劑效果期間獲得更高的魔力消耗效用。
hiddenEn: Supports skills with Cooldowns, causing them to grant Overflowing Chalice when used. Supported skills deal more damage during the effect of your Life Flask and have increased Mana Cost Efficiency during the effect of your Mana Flask.

hiddenZh: 輔助可升級的技能，若被輔助的技能沒有搭配其他輔助寶石，則賦予其許多額外等級。無法輔助無等級的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them many additional levels provided no other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

hiddenZh: 輔助可升級的技能，若被輔助的技能恰好搭配一顆其他輔助寶石，則賦予其額外等級。無法輔助無等級的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly two other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

hiddenZh: 輔助可升級的技能，若被輔助的技能恰好搭配一顆其他輔助寶石，則賦予其額外等級。無法輔助無等級的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly one other support is used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

hiddenZh: 輔助具有冷卻時間的非即時技能，為其額外賦予兩次冷卻用量，並根據你最近使用過的不同冷卻時間技能數量獲得更多傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports non-instant skills which have a cooldown, granting them two additional cooldown uses and more damage per different skill with a cooldown you have used recently.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何由自身使用的擊中敵人的技能，使其隨時間累積暴擊率。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time.

hiddenZh: 輔助你親自使用、會擊中敵人的任何技能，使其能隨時間累積暴擊機率，但會降低你的暴擊傷害加成。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time, but also reduce your Critical Damage Bonus.

hiddenZh: 輔助護盾技能，使你以被輔助的技能暈眩敵人時獲得守護。
hiddenEn: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.

hiddenZh: 輔助護盾技能，使你以被輔助的技能暈眩敵人時獲得守護。
hiddenEn: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的攻擊技能。使用被輔助的技能時，你的閃避值增加，且被輔助的技能的攻擊時間越長，增加幅度越高。無法輔助引導技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased Evasion Rating, with the increase scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用、造成擊中傷害的技能。未保持靜止不動一段時間，被輔助的技能便無法使用，但你保持靜止的時間越久，其傷害便會逐漸增加。無法輔助具有冷卻時間，或另一種使用條件的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills cannot be used unless you have been stationary for a certain duration, but deal increasingly more damage the longer you are stationary. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown or another usage Condition.

hiddenZh: 輔助能夠消耗盛怒的技能，在消耗盛怒時獲得一個增益效果。使用被輔助的技能時會消耗此增益效果並獲得盛怒。
啟動時會不斷的回復盛怒。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills you use yourself. On spending Rage with any skill you will gain a Buff. Using Supported Skills consumes this Buff to grant you Rage.
While active, you constantly regenerate Rage.

hiddenZh: 輔助主要技能。被輔助的技能產生能量的速度大幅加快。
hiddenEn: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.

hiddenZh: 輔助主要技能。被輔助的技能的能量產生大幅加快。
hiddenEn: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.

hiddenZh: 輔助生成痕跡的技能，使收集的痕跡會影響你存在範圍內的友方，而不會影響你自己。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that generate Remnants, causing those Remnants to affect Allies in your Presence when collected instead of you.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 範圍效果
輔助對一片範圍造成傷害的攻擊技能。被輔助的技能會大幅增加效果範圍，但命中附近目標的機率會有所降低。
hiddenEn: Supports Attack Skills which deal Damage in an Area. Supported Skills have significantly increased Area of Effect, but are less Accurate against nearby targets.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 召喚物, 範圍效果, 火焰
輔助,召喚物,範圍效果,火焰
輔助創造可被傷害之召喚物的技能，使其和附近敵人點燃。點燃的傷害根據被輔助召喚物的生命而定。
hiddenEn: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 召喚物, 範圍效果, 火焰
輔助,召喚物,範圍效果,火焰
輔助創造可被傷害之召喚物的技能，使其和附近敵人點燃。點燃的傷害根據被輔助召喚物的生命而定。
hiddenEn: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 召喚物, 範圍效果, 火焰
輔助,召喚物,範圍效果,火焰
輔助創造可被傷害之召喚物的技能，使其和附近敵人點燃。點燃的傷害根據被輔助召喚物的生命而定。
hiddenEn: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊
輔助打擊技能。被輔助的技能有機會在擊中時累積額外的連擊。不能輔助召喚物使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Strike Skills. Supported Skills have a chance to build additional Combo on Hit. Cannot support Skills used by Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 火焰, 持續時間
輔助,攻擊,火焰,持續時間
輔助自身使用且會擊中敵人的技能。以被輔助的技能暴擊時會在一段時間內以火焰傷害強化你的所有攻擊。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Critical Hits with Supported Skills imbue all of your Attacks with Fire damage for a duration.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 範圍效果, 火焰
輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，在短暫延遲後將其造成的點燃散播至附近的敵人。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, Spreading Ignites it inflicts to nearby enemies after a delay.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使點燃造成更高的傷害，但降低擊中造成的傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使點燃造成更高的傷害，但降低擊中造成的傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 範圍效果, 觸發, 火焰
輔助,範圍效果,觸發,火焰
輔助所有在施法時會造成魔符銘文的技能，使那些魔符銘文在失效時觸發爆燃銘文。爆燃銘文是一種會根據你的最大魔力來創造點燃地面的法術。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill which creates Runic Inscriptions when Cast, causing those Runic Inscriptions to trigger Burning Inscription when they expire. Burning Inscription is a Spell which creates Ignited Ground based off of your Maximum Mana.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 範圍效果, 觸發, 物理, 混沌
輔助,範圍效果,觸發,物理,混沌
輔助可讓敵人中毒的技能，中毒敵人會隨時間經過累積疫源，死亡時引起疫源爆發。無法輔助召喚物的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that can Poison enemies, causing Poisoned enemies to gain Plague over time and explode in a Plague Burst on death. Cannot support the skills of Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助物理技能，使其獲得 1 額外等級。不能輔助沒有等級的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Physical skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 召喚物, 持續, 持續時間
輔助,族裔,召喚物,持續,持續時間
輔助創造出持續召喚物的技能，使這些召喚物在承受致命傷害時仍可持續戰鬥，並在一小段時間後死亡。進入此狀態時，被輔助的技能的召喚物獲得噬魂者及瞬間加速。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that create Persistent Minions, causing those Minions to fight on when they are fatally wounded, dying after a duration. Minions from Supported Skills gain Soul Eater and a burst of speed on entering this state.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 混沌
輔助可造成傷害性擊中的技能。你的盛怒越高，被輔助的技能施加的中毒造成傷害的速度越快。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Poison inflicted with Supported Skills deals Damage faster the higher your Rage.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 火焰, 遣散
輔助 攻擊，使其對點燃的敵人造成額外的火焰傷害，但自身無法再點燃敵人。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, granting them extra Fire damage against Ignited enemies but making them unable to Ignite enemies themselves.

hiddenZh: 輔助奉獻技能。使用被輔助的技能時會犧牲你的一部分生命，但是造成更多傷害，並且獲得更強大的增益效果。
hiddenEn: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use, but deal much more damage and have more powerful Buffs in return.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用或由你觸發的攻擊技能，使其在擊中時消耗受招架減益效果，來賦予你一個狂怒球。無法輔助原本就會消耗受招架減益效果的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to Consume the Parried Debuff on Hit to grant you a Frenzy Charge. Cannot support Skills which already Consume the Parried Debuff.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的技能。若有可消耗的狂怒球，在使用被輔助的技能時，會消耗一顆狂怒球，使技能速度大幅提高。被輔助的技能不能產生狂怒球。無法輔助會消耗狂怒球的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a Frenzy Charge on use if possible, and will gain significant Skill Speed if they do, but cannot generate Frenzy Charges. Cannot Support Skills which consume Frenzy Charges.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 戰吼, 範圍效果, 觸發, 物理, 遣散
輔助,戰吼,範圍效果,觸發,物理,遣散
輔助戰吼技能。被輔助的技能會消耗完全破甲來觸發對範圍內敵人的物理傷害爆炸，但這些技能無法造成破甲。
hiddenEn: Support, Warcry, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Payoff
Supports Warcry Skills. Supported Skills Consume Fully Broken Armour to trigger Physical Damage explosions on Enemies within their range but cannot themselves Break Armour.

hiddenZh: 輔助會創造召喚物的技能，讓能夠以召喚物為目標的技能在情況允許時優先以被輔助的技能的召喚物而不是其他召喚物為目標。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Minions, causing your Skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill before your other Minions where possible.

hiddenZh: 輔助能製造召喚物的技能，讓能夠以召喚物為目標的技能在情況允許時優先以被輔助的技能的召喚物而不是其他召喚物為目標，並使其總是視為可引爆。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Minions, causing your Skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill before your other Minions where possible, as well as causing them to always be considered Detonatable.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 攻擊
輔助攻擊技能，賦予其攻擊速度，但犧牲傷害；或是賦予傷害，但犧牲攻擊速度，根據其使用的武器套裝而定。無法改變召喚物使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Attack skills, granting them Attack Speed at the cost of Damage or Damage at the cost of Attack Speed depending on Weapon Set they are used in. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助奉獻技能。 被輔助的技能在使用時會犧牲一定比例的自身血量。當被輔助的技能的奉獻尖刺存在時，你會週期性的獲得暴擊球。當被輔助的技能的尖刺消失時，根據該奉獻持續的時間按比例每秒回復一部分最大生命和魔力。
hiddenEn: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use. While Offering spikes from Supported Skills persist, you are periodically granted a Power Charge. When spikes from Supported Skills die, Regenerate a percentage of your maximum Life and Mana per second based on the duration the Offering persisted.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何可以造成傷害的技能，使其根據過去幾秒內所使用的不同號令技能數量造成更多傷害。無法改變召喚物技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill that can deal damage, causing it to deal more damage for each different Command Skill you have used in the past few seconds. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 戰吼, 冰冷, 持續時間
輔助,攻擊,戰吼,冰冷,持續時間
輔助自身使用的攻擊和戰吼技能。以被輔助的技能凍結一名敵人會短暫的以冰冷傷害強化自身和友方，持續一段時間。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with Supported Skills infuses you and your allies with Cold damage for a short time.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 物理
輔助攻擊，使其物理傷害偷取生命。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 物理
輔助攻擊，使其物理傷害偷取生命。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 物理
輔助攻擊技能，使其物理傷害可以偷取生命，且此方法獲得的偷取不會在滿血時被移除。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life and preventing Leech gained this way from being removed at full Life.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，在撲殺敵人時恢復生命。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Life when it Culls an enemy.

hiddenZh: 輔助會擊中敵人的技能，使其擊殺的敵人賦予更多的生命藥劑充能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it kills to grant more Life Flask charges.

hiddenZh: 輔助會造成傷害性擊中的技能，使被輔助的技能造成流血的基礎機率改為套用至中毒的基礎機率，並使中毒的基礎機率改為套用至流血機率。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits, causing base chance to inflict Bleeding with Supported Skills to instead apply to base chance to Poison, and causing base chance to Poison to instead apply to Bleeding.
Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.
Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.

hiddenZh: 輔助攻擊，使攻擊加快，但傷害減少。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster at the cost of Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助法術，使其施法速度加快。
hiddenEn: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.

hiddenZh: 輔助法術，使其施放得更快。
hiddenEn: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.

hiddenZh: 輔助法術，使你過去8秒每施展一個不同法術，使其施放得更快。
hiddenEn: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster for each different Spell you've cast in the last eight seconds.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 範圍效果, 觸發
輔助任何你可使用的技能，當你在使用期間遭擊暈，觸發一陣擊退敵人的暴風。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that you can use, triggering a blast of wind that Knocks Back enemies if you are Stunned while using it.

hiddenZh: 輔助會產生痕跡的技能，使這些痕跡更加強大。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful.

hiddenZh: 輔助會產生痕跡的技能，使這些痕跡更加強大，但延遲其效果。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.

hiddenZh: 輔助會產生痕跡的技能，使這些痕跡更加強大，但延遲其效果。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰
輔助由自身使用的近戰攻擊技能。被輔助的技能擊中的敵人身上每有一個元素異常狀態，便會造成更多的近戰傷害，但技能本身不會造成元素異常狀態。
