hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills deal more Melee Damage for each Elemental Ailment on Enemies they hit, but cannot themselves inflict Elemental Ailments.

hiddenZh: 輔助攻擊，使其癱瘓敵人。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, causing them to Maim enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 召喚物, 持續
輔助會召喚復甦召喚物的Minions技能。被輔助的召喚物若近期被復甦，造成的傷害則會大幅提高。
hiddenEn: Supports Minion Skills which summon Reviving Minions. Supported Minions deal significantly more Damage if they have Revived Recently.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 範圍效果, 觸發, 冰冷, 持續時間
輔助,法術,範圍效果,觸發,冰冷,持續時間
輔助生成冰晶的技能。被輔助的技能會生成冰緩區域，並造成冰冷持續傷害，而不是生成冰晶。
hiddenEn: Support, Spell, AoE, Trigger, Cold, Duration
Supports Skills which create Ice Crystals. Supported Skills create chilling areas which deal Cold Damage over time instead of creating Ice Crystals.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰
輔助近戰攻擊，使其在擊中時賦予盛怒。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰
輔助近戰攻擊，使其在擊中時賦予盛怒。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰
輔助近戰攻擊，使其在擊中時賦予盛怒。當你或被輔助的召喚物未達最大盛怒時，被輔助的技能的攻擊速度大幅提高。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit. Supported Skills have signficantly higher Attack speed while you or supported minion are not at maximum Rage.

hiddenZh: 輔助創造圖騰的技能。由被輔助的技能創造的圖騰會生成一個盛怒之泉，為身處其中的友方偷取盛怒。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Rage which will Leech Rage to Allies within it.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何由自身使用或觸發的傷害技能，使其消耗盛怒來造成更多傷害。如果你的盛怒不足，則無法獲得傷害加成。
hiddenEn: Supports any damaging skill that you use or Trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何由自身使用或觸發的傷害技能，使其消耗盛怒來造成更多傷害。有一定機率在不消耗盛怒下，仍視為已消耗而獲得效益。如果你的盛怒不足以消耗，則無法獲得傷害加成。
hiddenEn: Supports any damaging skill that you use or Trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage, with a chance to skip spending Rage while still benefitting as though it had. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 物理
輔助攻擊，使其根據造成物理傷害的一部分累積目眩。
輔助攻擊技能。被輔助的技能必會擊中目眩的敵人，但在擊中時消耗目眩，且自身無法造成目眩。無法輔助會消耗目眩的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, causing them to build up Daze based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.
Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills always hit Dazed Enemies, but Consume Daze on Hit, and cannot themselves inflict Daze. Cannot Support Skills which Consume Daze.

hiddenZh: 輔助戰吼，使其在使用時對敵人造成目眩。
hiddenEn: Supports Warcries, causing them to Daze Enemies on use.

hiddenZh: 輔助攻擊技能。以被輔助的技能擊中時會消耗癱瘓，破壞受癱瘓目標一定百分比的護甲值。被輔助的技能本身無法造成癱瘓。
hiddenEn: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills Consume Maim on hit, Breaking a percentage of the Maimed target's Armour in doing so. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict Maim.

hiddenZh: 輔助攻擊，使其對完全破甲的敵人造成目眩。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, causing them to Daze Enemies when they fully Break Armour.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 範圍效果, 混沌
輔助由自身使用的技能，使其在破壞敵人的能量護盾時觸發一道混沌傷害新星。
hiddenEn: Supports skills you use yourself, causing them to Trigger a Chaos Damage nova when breaking Enemy Energy Shield.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊, 持續時間
輔助,攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,重擊,持續時間
輔助重擊技能。被輔助的技能會在使用時消耗耐力球來產生碎裂地面。無法輔助會消耗耐力球的技能。
hiddenEn: Support, Attack, AoE, Melee, Slam, Duration
Supports Slam skills. Supported Skills will consume Endurance Charges on use to create Jagged Ground. Cannot Support Skills which consume Endurance Charges.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊, 持續時間
輔助,攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,重擊,持續時間
輔助重擊技能。被輔助重擊技能產生的餘震必定會產生碎裂地面。
hiddenEn: Support, Attack, AoE, Melee, Slam, Duration
Supports Slam skills. Aftershocks caused by Supported Slam Skills always create patches of Jagged Ground.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 範圍效果, 觸發, 持續性, 閃電, 遣散
輔助,法術,範圍效果,觸發,持續性,閃電,遣散
輔助會擊中敵人的技能。當被輔助的技能感電一名位於其他被感電的敵人周圍的敵人時，觸發電極裂隙，將周遭敵人不斷吸入，阻礙他們並每隔一段時間造成閃電傷害。
hiddenEn: Support, Spell, AoE, Trigger, Sustained, Lightning, Payoff

Supports Skills that Hit enemies. When Supported Skills Shock an enemy that is nearby other Shocked enemies, trigger Electromagnetism, sucking in nearby enemies, Hindering them, and dealing Lightning damage at an interval.

hiddenZh: 輔助生成痕跡的技能，使這些痕跡能在更遠的距離收集。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 觸發
輔助法術技能，使用後使其他技能冷卻時間縮短。不能輔助圖騰技能、引導施放技能、觸發技能、立即技能或保留技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Spell skills, causing them to reduce the cast time of other skills when used. Cannot support Totem skills, Channelling skills, Triggering skills, instant skills, or skills with a Reservation.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 投射物, 連鎖
輔助投射物和任何可以連鎖的技能，使他們連鎖更多次。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain more times.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 增益效果, 持續
輔助,族裔,增益效果,持續
輔助持續性的增益效果技能，使敵人有機率以你的抗性為 90% 計算其擊中傷害，該技能啟動期間生效。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, providing a chance for enemies to calculate their Hits as though your Resistances were 90% while the skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能。當附近敵人可觸電時會被標記，以被輔助的技能擊中被標記的敵人會對其造成觸電。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies. Nearby enemies are marked when they are Primed for Electrocution, and hitting a marked enemy with a supported skill will Electrocute them.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 範圍效果, 持續時間
輔助,範圍效果,持續時間
輔助躍至空中的技能，使其在你落地時生成奉獻地面。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Consecrated Ground when you land.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 持續時間
輔助你自己施放的法術，追蹤你施放法術所消耗的魔力。消耗足夠的魔力時，會獲得魔力回復和施法速度爆發。
hiddenEn: Supports Spells you cast yourself, tracking the mana you spend to cast them. Spending enough mana grants a burst of Mana Regeneration and Cast Speed.

hiddenZh: 輔助可爆發法術，使這些法術沿隨機軸向同時影響目標區域其中一側的額外區域爆發。
hiddenEn: Supports Cascadable Spells, causing them to Cascade to either side of the target area, along a randomly chosen axis.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續增益效果技能，使你在被輔助的技能啟動期間，於能量護盾全滿時造成的法術傷害增加。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Spell Damage while on full Energy Shield while the Supported Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續增益效果技能，使你在被輔助的技能啟動期間，於能量護盾全滿時造成的法術傷害增加。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Spell Damage while on full Energy Shield while the Supported Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的引導技能，使你在引導它們時提高暈眩門檻。
hiddenEn: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold while Channelling them.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的引導技能，使你在引導它們時提高暈眩門檻及異常狀態門檻。
hiddenEn: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold and Ailment Threshold  while Channelling them.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 物理
輔助攻擊，使它們在擊中時造成穿刺，但本身無法引出穿刺。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, causing them to Impale on Hit but making them unable to Extract Impale themselves.

hiddenZh: 輔助投射物技能，使其投射物穿透擊中的敵人，但穿透後造成的傷害會降低。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy but deal less damage after doing so.

hiddenZh: 輔助投射物技能，使其投射物穿透一名擊中的敵人。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy.

hiddenZh: 輔助投射物技能，使其投射物穿透所有擊中的敵人，但穿透後造成的傷害會減少。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an unlimited number of enemies, losing damage as they do so.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何造成傷害的技能。以被輔助的技能擊殺敵人時，有機率掉落一個維里西姆灌注痕跡。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill that deals damage. Enemies you kill with supported Skills have a chance to drop a Verisium Infusion Remnant.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 物理
輔助你使用或自行觸發的攻擊，使其消耗符文保護來使用，但會根據其符文保護消耗量造成額外物理傷害。不能輔助引導技能、持續技能或沒有消耗的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to cost Runic Ward to use but deal additional Physical damage based on their Runic Ward cost. Cannot Support Channelling Skills, Sustained Skills, or Skills without a cost.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 投射物, 觸發, 遣散
輔助,攻擊,投射物,觸發,遣散
輔助由自身使用的攻擊，使其消耗敵人的完全護甲破壞以消耗符文保護釋放一道符文投射物新星。投射物無法擊中其來源的敵人。無法輔助會消耗護甲破壞的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks you use yourself, causing them to Consume Fully Broken Armour on enemies to fire a nova of runic Projectiles at the cost of Runic Ward. The Projectiles cannot Hit the enemy from which they originated. Cannot support skills that Consume Broken Armour.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續性的增益技能，使你在該技能啟動期間，可以獲得更多的命中值。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Accuracy while the Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續性的增益技能，使你在該技能啟動期間，可以獲得更多的命中值。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Accuracy while the Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的攻擊技能。當被輔助的攻擊受到強化時，會大幅降低其消耗，並提高命中。
hiddenEn: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. When Supported Attacks are Empowered, they have significantly lowered cost and raised Accuracy.

hiddenZh: 輔助擊中敵人的法術，提升其傷害，但無法造成暴擊。
hiddenEn: Supports Spells that Hit enemies, boosting their damage but preventing them from dealing Critical Hits.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其較常暴擊，但造成更少的暴擊傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to Critically Hit more often but deal less damage with Critical Hits.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用、可造成傷害的技能。被輔助的技能會獲得一個等同於你智慧的能量護盾消耗，並會根據你的智慧來造成非異常狀態的持續傷害。無法輔助引導技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which you use yourself which can deal damage. Supported Skills gain an Energy Shield cost equal to your Intelligence, while also dealing more non-Ailment Damage over time based off of your Intelligence. Cannot support Channelling Skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 召喚物, 持續
輔助生成復甦的持續召喚物的技能。當那些召喚物陣亡時，你會補償最大魔力一定百分比的魔力。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Reviving Persistent Minions. When those Minions die, you Recoup a percentage of your maximum Mana.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用且會造成傷害性擊中的技能。被輔助的技能會在使用時消耗狂怒球並強力破甲。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills consume a Frenzy Charge on use to powerfully Break Armour.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 火焰, 混沌
輔助會造成傷害型擊中的技能，賦予其額外混沌傷害，並使混沌傷害貢獻至點燃。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Ignites.

hiddenZh: 輔助擊中敵人和自己施放的法術技能，犧牲施法速度來提高傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Spell Skills that Hit Enemies and you cast yourself, boosting Damage at the cost of Cast Speed.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的攻擊。每次使用被輔助的技能會提高其攻擊速度，但在短時間內過於頻繁使用，便無法使用該技能。持續技能則會改為在使用期間週期性的獲得攻擊速度。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills gain more Attack speed each time you use them, but will become unusable if used too frequently in a short time frame. Sustained Skills will instead gain Attack speed periodically while being used.

hiddenZh: 輔助產生冰晶的技能。來自被輔助的技能的冰晶爆炸並造成傷害時，將會穿刺敵人。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Ice Crystals. Damaging Explosions caused by Ice Crystals from Supported Skills will Impale Enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助完美時機時使用具有效益的技能。成功在完美時機擊中敵人時，被輔助的技能會給予至少一顆耐力球。
hiddenEn: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfect Timing. Supported Skills grant at least one Endurance Charge when Hitting an enemy with Perfect Timing.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何技能，使得施加的緩速效果更強。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill, causing inflicted Slows to be more powerful.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何具持續時間的技能，縮短其持續時間。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that has a duration making that duration shorter.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何具持續時間的技能，縮短其持續時間。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that has a duration making that duration shorter.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 召喚物
輔助可創造能受到傷害的盟友的技能。由被輔助的技能產生的召喚物會承受你原本要承受的一部分擊中傷害，但其最大生命減少。以此方式承受的一部分傷害會補償為你的生命。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life. A percentage of Damage taken this way is Recouped by you as Life.

hiddenZh: 輔助所產生物件遭擊中數次後會被破壞的技能，使其可承受額外次數的擊中。無法修改由召喚物使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create objects that are destroyed after being Hit a number of times, allowing for them to last for additional Hits. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

hiddenZh: 弓, 輔助, 攻擊, 投射物
hiddenEn: DNT-UNUSED Supports Bow Attacks you use yourself. Supported Attacks fire multiple projectiles into the air,

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 投射物
輔助弓的攻擊。被輔助的技能會指示四個方向的其中一個，並會在被輔助的技能之攻擊與該方向相符時變換。朝該方向施放的被輔助的技能之攻擊會造成更多傷害。無法輔助引導技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 投射物
輔助弓的攻擊。被輔助的技能會指示四個方向的其中一個，並會在被輔助的技能之攻擊與該方向相符時變換。朝該方向施放的被輔助的技能之攻擊會造成更多傷害。無法輔助引導技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 投射物
輔助弓的攻擊。被輔助的技能會指示四個方向的其中一個，並會在被輔助的技能之攻擊與該方向相符時變換。朝該方向施放的被輔助的技能之攻擊會發射額外投射物。無法輔助引導技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction fire additional Projectiles. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助創造召喚物的技能，使其承受更少傷害，但造成更少傷害。無法輔助創造無法被傷害的召喚物的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助創造召喚物的技能，使其承受更少傷害，但造成更少傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助主要技能。被輔助的技能在觸發或祈求其他技能時，有機率返還一部分的能量消耗。
hiddenEn: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills gain a chance to partially Refund a portion of Energy cost when Triggering or Invoking other Skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何你可以使用的技能，當你在使用期間被擊暈，會立即開始恢復能量護盾。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that you can use, causing Energy Shield recharge to begin immediately if you are Stunned while using it.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何消耗能量球的技能，賦予一定機率使該次消耗獲得的增益加倍。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill that Consumes Charges, granting a chance for benefits of that Consumption to be doubled.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 觸發, 混沌, 持續時間, 詛咒
輔助,法術,觸發,混沌,持續時間,詛咒
輔助詛咒技能。被輔助的技能會在每個受其詛咒的目標身上觸發瀆神衰敗，施加造成傷害的減益效果。
hiddenEn: Support, Spell, Trigger, Chaos, Duration, Curse
Supports Curse skills. Supported skill Trigger Profane Decay on each target they curse to inflict a damaging Debuff.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 召喚物, 持續, 持續時間
輔助,召喚物,持續,持續時間
輔助創造出持續召喚物的技能，使這些召喚物在承受致命傷害時仍可持續戰鬥，並在一小段時間後死亡。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that create Persistent Minions, causing those Minions to fight on when they are fatally wounded, dying after a short duration.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 彈藥, 投射物
輔助十字弓彈藥技能，使其沉重暈眩一名敵人時自動裝填。
hiddenEn: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

hiddenZh: 輔助捷光環技能，使其觸發效果造成更高的傷害，但其精魂消耗提高。
hiddenEn: Supports Herald Skills, making their triggered effects deal more damage at the expense of higher Spirit cost.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其造成更少傷害，但造成更強力的中毒。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Poison.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其造成更少傷害，但造成更強效的中毒。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Poison.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 觸發, 物理, 引導, 獲得疊層
輔助,攻擊,範圍效果,觸發,物理,引導,獲得疊層
輔助由自身施放的 引導技能。當以被輔助的技能引導時，週期性的獲得致死決意層數。在你受到擊中時消耗一層，並在自身周遭觸發一道致命的爆炸，爆炸的傷害根據護甲增加。
hiddenEn: Support, Attack, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Channelling, Staged

Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself. While Channelling Supported Skills, periodically gain stages of Deadly Resolve. Expend a stage of Deadly Resolve when an enemy Hits you to Trigger a deadly slash towards that enemy, dealing more damage based on your Armour.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何擊中敵人的技能，使其擊中時致盲敵人。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to Blind on Hit.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何擊中敵人的技能，使其擊中時致盲敵人且效果增加。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to Blind on Hit with increased effect.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何可以擊中敵人的技能，目標身上越多中毒效果，使其造成的傷害逐漸提高。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to deal increasingly higher damage the more Poisons are on the target.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 閃電, 混沌
輔助會造成傷害型擊中的技能，賦予其額外混沌傷害，並使混沌傷害貢獻至感電。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Shock.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 閃電
輔助擊中目標的閃電技能，為其賦予額外一個等級，並使其對閃電傷害只擲出最低或最高值。無法輔助無等級的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Lightning Skills that Hit, granting them an additional level and causing them to only roll the minimum or maximum value for Lightning damage. Does not Support Skills which do not have levels.

hiddenZh: 輔助可消耗連擊的技能。以被輔助的技能消耗連擊時，你有機率會根據消耗的連擊數量獲得暴擊球。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which can expend Combo. On expending Combo with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain Power Charges based on the amount of Combo expended.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 法術, 投射物
輔助發射火焰投射物的法術技能，使施法速度的增減同時套用至投射物速度。
hiddenEn: Supports Spell Skills that fire Projectiles, causing increases and reductions to cast speed to also apply to Projectile speed.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續增益效果技能，使你在被輔助的技能啟動期間造成的荊棘傷害增加。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續增益效果技能，使你在被輔助的技能啟動期間造成的荊棘傷害增加。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊, 觸發, 物理, 危險, 植物
輔助,攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,重擊,觸發,物理,危險,植物
輔助重擊技能。被輔助的技能會在地面上產生危險荊棘。接觸這些荊棘的敵人會承受傷害並受癱瘓。無法修改由召喚物或圖騰使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Support, Attack, AoE, Melee, Slam, Trigger, Physical, Hazard, Plant
Supports Slam Skills, making them Trigger Brambles to create Hazardous brambles which damage and Maim enemies. Does not modify Skills used by Minions or Totems.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 法術, 範圍效果, 觸發, 物理, 閃電, 冰冷, 火焰, 混沌, 詛咒
輔助,族裔,法術,範圍效果,觸發,物理,閃電,冰冷,火焰,混沌,詛咒
輔助詛咒技能，使其擁有短暫的冷卻時間，但會產生使範圍內敵人受到詛咒的區域。來自被輔助的技能的被詛咒區域會積蓄能量，並在延遲後噴發一道毀天滅地的光束。
hiddenEn: Support, Lineage, Spell, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Chaos, Curse

Supports Curse Skills, giving them a short cooldown but causing them to create areas which Curse enemies so long as they are within them. Cursed areas from Supported Skills gather power before erupting in a column of annihilating light after a moderate delay.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 觸發, 冰冷, 持續時間, 遣散
輔助,族裔,觸發,冰冷,持續時間,遣散
輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其造成更多傷害，並在消耗敵人身上的冰凍時觸發自然交換。無法輔助會消耗冰凍的技能。
hiddenEn: Support, Lineage, Trigger, Cold, Duration, Payoff
Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage and trigger Nature's Exchange when consuming Freeze on enemies. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 彈藥, 投射物
輔助十字弓彈藥技能，使其裝填多發額外弩箭。被輔助的技能無法正常重新裝填，而是在你躲避時裝填弩箭。
hiddenEn: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load multiple extra bolts and attack faster. Supported Skills cannot reload normally, instead loading bolts when you Dodge.

hiddenZh: 輔助會造成傷害型擊中的技能，使其擊中將敵人元素抗性視為顛倒。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, causing those Hits to treat Enemy Elemental Resistances as inverted.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的引導技能，使其引導的時間越長，造成的傷害越高。
hiddenEn: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的引導技能，使其引導的時間越長，造成的傷害越高。
hiddenEn: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 投射物, 觸發, 持續時間, 危險
輔助,攻擊,範圍效果,投射物,觸發,持續時間,危險
輔助遠程長矛攻擊。被輔助的技能生成的投射物抵達飛行終點時，便會生成蒺藜。
hiddenEn: Support, Attack, AoE, Projectile, Trigger, Duration, Hazard
Supports Ranged Spear Attacks. Supported Skills create Caltrops when Projectiles they create reach the end of their flight.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 範圍效果, 觸發, 印記, 持續時間
輔助,法術,範圍效果,觸發,印記,持續時間
輔助印記技能，使其啟動時觸發蓄電印記。 蓄電印記會在目標位置創造感電地面。
hiddenEn: Support, Spell, AoE, Trigger, Mark, Duration
Supports Mark Skills, causing them to Trigger Charged Mark when they are Activated. Charged Mark creates Shocked Ground at the target's location.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 觸發
輔助會觸發其他技能的技能。由被輔助的技能所觸發的技能，在被觸發時的傷害、效果範圍及投射物速度會隨機提高或降低，且在觸發時會恢復隨機比例的消耗量。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage, Area of Effect, and Projectile Speed randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續性的增益技能，使你在該技能啟動期間，可以從藥劑獲得更多的生命恢復。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Life recovery from Flasks while the Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續增益效果的技能，使你在該技能啟動期間，可以從藥劑獲得更多的生命恢復。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Life recovery from Flasks while the Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其對貧血敵人造成更多傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其對貧血狀態的敵人造成更多傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其對貧血狀態的敵人造成更多傷害，且當你在貧血狀態時，會造成更多傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life, as well as dealing more damage while you are on Low Life.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 觸發, 物理
輔助,攻擊,範圍效果,觸發,物理
輔助由自身使用、造成擊中傷害的攻擊技能。被輔助的技能在擊中時消耗流血，以產生具充滿血液的爆炸性晶體，但本身無法造成流血。無法輔助已經會消耗流血的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Bleeding on Hit to create explosive blood-filled crystals, but cannot themselves inflict Bleeding. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Bleeding.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 打擊
輔助,攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,打擊
輔助近戰、打擊、和疾風攻擊技能，使其沉重暈眩一名敵人時，創造出一道餘震，對目標周圍敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Strike Skills and Wind Attack Skills, causing them to create an Aftershock that damages enemies around the target when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 物理, 混沌
輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，造成中毒並且會破壞敵人的護甲。無法輔助會消耗完全破甲的護甲的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Poison it applies to also Break enemy Armour. Cannot support skills that Consume Fully Broken Armour.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 投射物, 閃電, 冰冷
輔助,族裔,投射物,閃電,冰冷
輔助由自身使用的、發射投射物且原本沒有冷卻時間的閃電或冰冷技能，為其新增冷卻時間，使投射物在穿透目標後返回。
hiddenEn: Supports Lightning or Cold skills you use yourself which fire Projectiles and do not already have cooldowns, adding a cooldown and making the Projectiles return, piercing through targets as they do so.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 閃電, 冰冷
輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其冰凍或觸電的敵人被護甲破壞。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Break Armour of enemies it Freezes or Electrocutes.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的技能。被輔助的技能在使用時會消耗一個屍體，造成更多混沌傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume a Corpse on use, dealing more Chaos Damage if they do.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的技能。被輔助的技能在使用時會消耗多具屍體，每消耗一具屍體造成更多混沌傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume many Corpses on use, dealing more Chaos Damage per Corpse consumed.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 法術, 投射物
輔助投射物法術。被輔助的法術按遞增機率以環形發射更多額外的投射物。引起環狀發射後機率重置。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have an increasingly higher chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle, resetting when they do.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 圖騰
輔助會創造圖騰的技能，使你無法擁有超過一根該圖騰，但是會根據周遭的友方圖騰給予被輔助的圖騰大量增益。無法輔助召喚物使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing you from having more than one of that Totem but granting significant benefits for Supported Totems based how many allied Totems are near them. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助詛咒技能。被輔助的詛咒技能會產生區域，只要敵人在這些區域內，就會受到詛咒。
hiddenEn: Supports Curse Skills. Supported Curse Skills create areas which Curse Enemies so long as they are within them.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 召喚物, 號令
輔助帶有號令技能的召喚物。被輔助的召喚物使用的號令技能有大幅提高的冷卻恢復速度，但非號令技能不會造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Minions which have Command Skills. Supported Minions have massively increased cooldown recovery speed for Command Skills they use, but deal no damage with non-Command Skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用、擊中敵人時會造成傷害的技能。被輔助的技能會消耗一定百分比的最大生命藥劑充能，並根據消耗的生命藥劑充能來造成更強力的流血效果。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用、擊中敵人時會造成傷害的技能。被輔助的技能會消耗一定百分比的最大生命藥劑充能，並根據消耗的生命藥劑充能來造成更強力的流血效果。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 戰吼, 範圍效果, 觸發, 火焰, 遣散
輔助,攻擊,戰吼,範圍效果,觸發,火焰,遣散
輔助攻擊和戰吼，使其完全破壞敵人護甲時觸發火焰爆炸。
hiddenEn: Support, Attack, Warcry, AoE, Trigger, Fire, Payoff
Supports Attacks and Warcries, causing them to trigger a Fiery explosion when they Fully Break an enemy's Armour.

hiddenZh: 輔助擊中敵人的技能，使擊中根據造成物理傷害的一部分造成破甲。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.

hiddenZh: 輔助會擊中敵人的技能，使擊中根據造成物理傷害的一部分造成破甲。以被輔助的技能完全破甲時，你有機率會獲得一顆耐力球。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt. On Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain an Endurance Charge.

hiddenZh: 輔助會擊中敵人的技能，使擊中根據造成物理傷害的一部分造成破甲。以被輔助的技能完全破甲時，你有機率獲得一顆耐力球。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt. On Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain an Endurance Charge.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何技能，加強其破甲效果。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何技能，加強其破甲效果。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其擊殺的敵人賦予更多護符充能。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Charm charges.

hiddenZh: 輔助創造召喚物的技能，使其造成和承受更多傷害。無法輔助創造無法被傷害的召喚物的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports skills which create Minions, making them deal and take more damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 範圍效果, 觸發, 火焰
輔助,族裔,範圍效果,觸發,火焰
輔助會躍至空中的技能，使你著地位置周遭的屍體劇烈的爆炸，對周遭敵人造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing Corpses in the area you land to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 物理
輔助攻擊技能。被輔助的技能所造成的流血持續時間大幅延長，但你以被輔助的技能對敵人施加流血後，也會使其移動和攻擊加快。
hiddenEn: Supports Attack Skills. Bleeding inflicted with Supported Skills lasts significantly longer, but enemies you inflict Bleeding onto with Supported Skills will move and Attack faster.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其暴擊造成更多傷害，但降低暴擊率。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage with Critical Hits but have less Critical Hit chance.

hiddenZh: 輔助會擊中敵人的技能，使擊中根據造成物理傷害的一部分對流血敵人造成跛行。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Hobble Bleeding Enemies based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，對敵人造成重度擊暈時施加破甲。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to apply Broken Armour to enemies when causing a Heavy Stun to enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助攻擊，使其根據敵人與你的距離遠近，對敵人造成更多傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.

hiddenZh: 輔助攻擊，使其根據敵人與你的距離遠近，對敵人造成更多傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 戰吼, 範圍效果, 條件
輔助,戰吼,範圍效果,條件
輔助戰吼。被輔助的技能會迴響兩次，並隨著次數擴大範圍，但降低效果且需求你在再次使用之前移動一段距離。
hiddenEn: Supports Warcries. Supported Skills Echo twice, and their area grows larger each time, but are less effective and require you to have travelled a certain distance before use.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰
輔助近戰攻擊。若你在過去八秒內以投射物攻擊擊中，被輔助的技能造成的近戰傷害便會提高，但自身不會造成投射物傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰
輔助近戰攻擊。若你在過去八秒內以投射物攻擊擊中，被輔助的技能造成的近戰傷害便會提高，但自身不會造成投射物傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰
輔助近戰攻擊。若你在過去兩秒內以投射物攻擊擊中，被輔助的技能造成的近戰傷害便會提高，但自身不會造成投射物傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰
輔助近戰攻擊技能。被輔助的技能擊退敵人時會施加易攻目標，使他們被下一個投射物攻擊擊中時，受到更多傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills apply Easy Target when Knocking Back Enemies, causing the next Projectile Attack Hit they take to deal increased Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊
輔助會在連擊最後造成最終打擊的打擊技能，使你可以連續使用兩次最終打擊。
hiddenEn: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, allowing you to use the Final Strike twice in succession.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊
輔助會在連擊最後造成最終打擊的打擊技能，使你可以連續使用兩次最終打擊。同時，非最終打擊的攻擊會加快。
hiddenEn: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, allowing you to use the Final Strike twice in succession, and causing Non-Final Strike Attacks to be faster.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊
輔助會在連擊最後造成最終打擊的打擊技能，使最終打擊受到先祖強化。
hiddenEn: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to be Ancestrally Boosted.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 條件
輔助,攻擊,近戰,打擊,條件
輔助由自身使用的近戰攻擊。在累積足夠的連擊之前，被輔助的技能無法使用，但可提高造成的傷害。無法輔助已經具有連擊的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until enough Combo has been built up, but deal more damage. Cannot support skills which already Combo.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 打擊, 條件
輔助,攻擊,近戰,打擊,條件
輔助由自身使用的近戰攻擊。在累積足夠的連擊之前，被輔助的技能無法使用，但可大幅提高造成的傷害。無法輔助已經具有連擊的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until enough Combo has been built up, but deal massively more damage. Cannot support skills which already Combo.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 投射物, 連鎖
輔助投射物技能和任何其它會連鎖的技能，使其造成額外連鎖次數。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 投射物, 連鎖
輔助投射物技能和任何其它會連鎖的技能，使其造成額外連鎖次數。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 投射物, 連鎖
輔助投射物技能和任何其它會連鎖的技能，使其造成額外連鎖次數。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

hiddenZh: 輔助能製造地表的技能，讓那些地面隨時間經過而擴大，直至達到大小限制。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those Surfaces to grow over time, up to a limit.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的攻擊技能。被輔助的技能的暴擊會造成更多傷害，但暴擊一名敵人會使自己短時間受到目眩。
hiddenEn: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills deal more Damage with Critical Hits, but Critically Hitting an Enemy with them will Daze you for a short time.

hiddenZh: 輔助那些同時只能擁有有限數量效果的技能，增加該上限，但會縮短效果持續時間。僅適用於使用「上限」一詞的限制。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which have a Limit, increasing that Limit at the cost of their duration. Only applies to restrictions that use the word "Limit".

hiddenZh: 輔助那些同時只能擁有有限數量效果的技能，增加該上限，但會縮短效果持續時間。僅適用於使用「上限」一詞的限制。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which have a Limit, increasing that Limit at the cost of their duration. Only applies to restrictions that use the word "Limit".

hiddenZh: 輔助同時只能擁有有限數量效果的技能，將上限增加至兩倍，但使用時會詛咒你自己。僅適用於使用「上限」一詞的限制。無法輔助持續技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which have a Limit, doubling that Limit, but Cursing yourself on Supported Skill use. Only applies to restrictions that use the word "Limit". Cannot support Persistent Skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何有等級的技能，增加其等級和品質，並減少其消耗和保留。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill which has levels, increasing the level and Quality, while reducing the cost and Reservation.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的攻擊技能。 若你被包圍，被輔助的技能的擊中傷害會帶有幸運。
hiddenEn: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky if you are Surrounded.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用的攻擊技能。 若你被包圍，被輔助的技能的擊中傷害會視為帶來幸運，而魔力不足不會導致被輔助的技能無法使用。
hiddenEn: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky and Insufficient Mana doesn't prevent Supported Skills from being used if you are Surrounded.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其造成額外中毒，但縮短中毒持續時間。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing it to inflict an extra Poison on enemies but shortening the duration of those Poisons.

hiddenZh: 輔助攻擊，使其在遠處造成更多傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage from farther away.

hiddenZh: 輔助攻擊，使其在遠處造成更多傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage from farther away.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰
輔助近戰攻擊技能，被輔助的技能會使沉重暈眩累積得更快，但其本身無法沉重暈眩。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Heavy Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Heavy Stun.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰
輔助近戰攻擊技能，被輔助的技能會使暈眩累積得更快，但其本身無法暈眩。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Stun.

hiddenZh: 輔助會產生危險的技能。被輔助的技能產生的危險有機會在觸發後重新佈署一小段時間。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.

hiddenZh: 輔助會產生危險的技能。被輔助的技能產生的危險有機會在觸發後重新佈署一小段時間。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 觸發
輔助,攻擊,範圍效果,觸發
輔助快行技能，使用該技能後，你的腳步會使大地崩毀並射出會造成傷害的衝擊波。
hiddenEn: Supports Travel skills, causing your footsteps to crack the earth and emit damaging shockwaves while using the skill.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何造成傷害的技能，犧牲所有其他傷害類型提高其物理傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何造成傷害的技能，犧牲所有其他傷害類型提高其物理傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何造成傷害的技能，犧牲所有其他傷害類型來提升其物理傷害，並使該技能的擊中有機率無視物理傷害減免。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types, as well as giving Hits from that skill a chance to ignore Physical Damage reduction.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 投射物
輔助投射物法術。被輔助的法術有機率以環形發射更多額外的投射物。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 投射物
輔助投射物法術。被輔助的法術有機率以環形發射更多額外的投射物。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其物理傷害可以釘身，但無法再擊暈敵人。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其物理傷害可以釘身，但無法再擊暈敵人，同時賦予對於受禁錮敵人的暴擊率。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun, as well as granting Critial Hit Chance against Immobilised enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其物理傷害可以釘身，但無法再擊暈敵人。被輔助的技能的釘身累積會減少，但釘身持續時間大幅延長。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun. Pin buildup caused by Supported Skill is lessened, but Pin duration is significantly longer.

hiddenZh: 輔助擊中時會造成傷害的技能。當被輔助的技能釘身一名敵人時，也會使該敵人加劇流血。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which deal Damage with Hits. When Supported Skills Pin an Enemy, they also Aggravate Bleeding on that Enemy.

hiddenZh: 輔助具有引爆時間的技能，使這些技能的引爆時間明顯延長、爆炸傷害明顯提高。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助具有引爆時間的技能，使這些技能的引爆時間明顯延長、爆炸傷害明顯提高。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何造成傷害的技能，使其獲得閃電傷害，但造成更少冰冷和火焰傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Lightning Damage but deal less Cold and Fire Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助閃電技能，使其獲得 1 額外等級。不能輔助沒有等級的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Lightning skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 閃電, 持續時間
輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其感電時造成曝曬。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when inflicting Shock.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何可擊中敵人的技能，使擊中穿透敵人閃電抗性。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Lightning resistance.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 混沌
輔助造成非異常狀態混沌持續傷害的法術，使其造成的持續傷害同時也會阻礙敵人。無法輔助召喚物使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment Chaos damage over time, causing damage over time they inflict to also Hinder enemies. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 召喚物, 持續
輔助持續召喚物技能。使被輔助的召喚物為你而死時，有機率獲得一條深淵怪物詞綴。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Minion Skills, granting a chance when Supported Minions die for you to gain an Abyssal Monster Modifier.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 物理
輔助任何技能，使其一部分的魔力消耗轉換為消耗生命。無法輔助保留精魂的技能。被輔助的技能會獲得相當於部分生命消耗的額外物理傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill, turning a portion of its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit. Supported Skills Gain a portion of their Life cost as extra Physical Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助由自身使用、且具有冷卻時間的技能，大幅增加其冷卻時間恢復率速度，但使用時會使你失去生命、魔力和能量護盾。無法輔助主要技能或持續技能，或改變召喚物的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills you use yourself that have Cooldowns, dramatically increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover, but causing you to lose Life, Mana, and Energy Shield when they are used. Cannot Support Meta Skills or Persistent Skills, or modify the Skills of Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 持續
輔助常駐技能，使其保留生命而非精魂。無法輔助會創造召喚物的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Skills, making them Reserve Life instead of Spirit. Cannot Support Skills which create Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 法術, 範圍效果, 觸發
輔助,族裔,法術,範圍效果,觸發
DNT-UNUSED Supports Spells you use yourself which Hit enemies. On Critical Hit with supported Spells, Trigger Atziri's Storm at the location of the nearest enemy.
hiddenEn: DNT-UNUSED Supports Spells you use yourself which Hit enemies. On Critical Hit with supported Spells, Trigger Atziri's Storm at the location of the nearest enemy.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 詛咒
輔助你自身施放的詛咒法術技能，使這些詛咒無視一般詛咒上限，但會反射至你身上。
hiddenEn: Supports Curse Spells you cast yourself, causing those Curses to ignore the usual Curse Limit, but be reflected back to you when inflicted.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 觸發, 火焰, 持續時間
輔助,攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,觸發,火焰,持續時間
輔助會躍至空中的近戰技能，使你在落地時創造裂縫。不能輔助圖騰技能，且無法修該召喚物使用的技能。
hiddenEn: Support, Attack, AoE, Melee, Trigger, Fire, Duration
Supports Melee Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Fissures when you land. Cannot Support Totem Skills, and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何有範圍效果的技能，使該範圍變得更小，但其造成的任何範圍傷害更高。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill with an area of effect, causing that area to be smaller but any area damage it deals to be higher.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰
輔助由自身使用的近戰攻擊。使用被輔助的技能時會消耗所有耐力球，讓你每消耗一個能量球，就恢復最大生命一定百分比的生命。無法輔助會消耗耐力球的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills Consume all Endurance Charge on use, causing you to restore a percentage of your maximum Life for each Charge Consumed. Cannot Support Skills which consume Endurance Charges.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 彈藥, 投射物
輔助十字弓彈藥技能，使其犧牲裝填速度來額外裝填一發弩箭。
hiddenEn: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 彈藥, 投射物
輔助十字弓彈藥技能，使其犧牲裝填速度來額外裝填一發弩箭。
hiddenEn: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 彈藥, 投射物
輔助十字弓彈藥技能，使其犧牲裝填速度來額外裝填一發弩箭。以被輔助的技能對敵人造成沉重暈眩時，也會自動裝填。
hiddenEn: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed. Supported Skills will also automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 投射物, 觸發, 閃電, 連鎖
輔助,法術,投射物,觸發,閃電,連鎖
輔助會擊中敵人的技能。以被輔助的技能感電一名敵人時觸發雷鳴湍流，向周遭濕透的敵人發射連鎖閃電投射物。
hiddenEn: Support, Spell, Projectile, Trigger, Lightning, Chaining
Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Shocking an enemy with Supported Skills Triggers Coursing Current, which sends Chaining Lightning Projectiles to nearby Drenched enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助所有能夠造成傷害的技能。被輔助的技能造成的閃電傷害可以引發觸電，但被輔助的技能無法造成感電。
hiddenEn: Supports any Skill which can deal Damage. Lightning Damage from Supported Skills can inflict Electrocute, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Shock.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 投射物, 閃電
輔助由自身使用的投射物攻擊技能。當你移動時，被輔助的技能會獲得電流充能，直至達到上限。使用時，被輔助的技能會消耗充能，獲得額外閃電傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain Voltaic Charge as you move, up to a maximum. When used, Supported Skills expend that Charge to gain extra Lightning Damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其擊殺感電敵人時恢復能量護盾。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Energy Shield when it kills a Shocked enemy.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 閃電, 引導
輔助引導技能。引導被輔助的技能時，你會根據最大魔力獲得閃電荊棘。
hiddenEn: Supports Channelling Skills. While Channelling Supported Skills, you gain Lightning Thorns based off of your maximum Mana.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 範圍效果, 持續時間
輔助,範圍效果,持續時間
輔助會躍至空中並造成傷害的技能，使其首次對敵人造成暴擊時創造感電地面。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills that leap into the air and deal damage, causing them to create Shocked Ground the first time they Critically Hit an enemy.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 重擊
輔助你親自使用的重擊，使其在重擊後方同時產生餘震，但會降低被輔助的技能的餘震傷害與效果範圍。無法輔助會產生裂縫的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Slams you use yourself, causing them to create simultaneous Aftershocks behind the Slam, but lowering Aftershock damage and area of effect with Supported Skills. Cannot Support Skills which create Fissures.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 物理
輔助會擊中敵人的法術。被輔助的技能以物理傷害暴擊敵人時會施加目眩。
hiddenEn: Supports Spells which Hit enemies. Supported Skills Daze on Critically Hitting enemies with Physical damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 重擊, 觸發
輔助,攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,重擊,觸發
輔助攻擊，使其在沉重暈眩時從敵人位置處釋放一道符文震波。震波會消耗符文保護，且不會在你沒有足夠符文保護時觸發。
hiddenEn: Support, Attack, AoE, Melee, Slam, Trigger
Supports Attacks, causing a Runic Shockwave to erupt under enemies they Heavy Stun. The Shockwave costs Runic Ward, and will not Trigger if you do not have enough Runic Ward.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 戰吼, 冰冷, 持續時間
輔助,戰吼,冰冷,持續時間
輔助由自身使用的傷害性技能和戰吼。以被輔助的技能冰凍一名敵人時會短暫的以冰冷傷害強化你的攻擊。
hiddenEn: Supports damaging skills and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with supported skills infuses your damage with Cold damage for a short time.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 戰吼, 冰冷, 持續時間
輔助,戰吼,冰冷,持續時間
輔助由自身使用的傷害性技能和戰吼。以被輔助的技能冰凍一名敵人時會短暫的以冰冷傷害強化你的攻擊。
hiddenEn: Supports damaging skills and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with supported skills infuses your damage with Cold damage for a short time.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 冰冷, 火焰, 遣散
輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，在點燃一名冰凍敵人時消耗冰凍，強化點燃效果。無法輔助會消耗冰凍或點燃的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Consume Freeze on Igniting a Frozen enemy to boost the effect of the Ignite. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze or Ignite.

hiddenZh: 輔助創造地表的技能，使被那些地表冰緩的敵人更容易被冰凍，但會犧牲部分冰緩幅度。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing Enemies Chilled by those Surfaces to be more easily Frozen, but at the cost of some Chill magnitude.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 彈藥, 投射物
輔助十字弓彈藥技能，使裝填弩箭的速度大幅加快。
hiddenEn: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to Reload bolts significantly faster.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 投射物
輔助你自己以弓或長矛使用的投射物攻擊。被輔助的技能初始會造成較低的傷害，但會生成靈體投射物，並在發射時造成較高傷害。靈體投射物會持續存在，並在一小段時間內未產生新的靈體投射物後發射。無法輔助引導技能、跳躍技能或從上方降下投射物的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Bow or Spear Projectile Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills deal lower damage initially, but generate Spectral Projectiles, which deal more damage when they fire. Spectral Projectiles linger and will fire a short duration after no new Spectral Projectiles have been created. Cannot support Channelling Skills, Leaping skills, or skills which rain Projectiles from above.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 範圍效果, 觸發, 持續性, 閃電, 持續時間
輔助,法術,範圍效果,觸發,持續性,閃電,持續時間
輔助會擊中敵人的技能。以被輔助的技能擊中一名敵人並使其感電時會 觸發靜電震盪，使該敵人成為 閃電傷害的來源，向周朝敵人持續發射脈衝。
hiddenEn: Support, Spell, AoE, Trigger, Sustained, Lightning, Duration

Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Shocking an enemy with Hits from Supported Skills Triggers Static Shocks, causing that enemy to become a source of Lightning damage sending pulses towards nearby enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 條件
輔助近戰攻擊技能。當你以其他近戰攻擊成功打擊敵人時，被輔助的技能會獲得連擊。被輔助的技能使用時會重置其連擊，並根據使用時擁有的連擊越高，造成更多傷害。無法輔助已會獲得連擊的技能。無法改變召喚物的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 條件
輔助近戰攻擊技能。當你以其他近戰攻擊成功打擊敵人時，被輔助的技能會獲得連擊。被輔助的技能使用時會重置其連擊，並根據使用時擁有的連擊越高，造成更多傷害。無法輔助已會獲得連擊的技能。無法改變召喚物的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助可強化本身以外技能的技能，使強化的技能造成更多傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports skills that can Empower skills other than themselves, causing skills they Empower to deal more damage.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 投射物, 閃電, 連鎖
輔助投射物技能以及可連鎖的技能。當最初擊中一名感電的敵人時，被輔助的技能必定會連鎖，但本身無法造成感電。無法輔助不會連鎖的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Projectile Skills and Skills which can Chain. Supported Skills always Chain when initially Hitting a Shocked Enemy, but cannot themselves inflict Shock. Does not support Skills which cannot Chain.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 召喚物, 觸發, 物理, 持續時間
輔助,召喚物,觸發,物理,持續時間
輔助會產生可粉碎土製物件的技能。在這些物件範圍內擊殺足夠數量的敵人後，這些物件會粉碎，釋放飛掠之石召喚物。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 召喚物, 觸發, 物理, 持續時間
輔助,召喚物,觸發,物理,持續時間
輔助會產生可粉碎土製物件的技能。在這些物件範圍內擊殺足夠數量的敵人後，這些物件會粉碎，釋放飛掠之石召喚物。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 範圍效果, 觸發, 植物
輔助,法術,範圍效果,觸發,植物
輔助植物技能，使它們在過度生長後觸發一次爆炸。
hiddenEn: Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 範圍效果, 觸發, 植物
輔助,法術,範圍效果,觸發,植物
輔助植物技能，使它們在過度生長後觸發一陣爆炸，並使被擊中的敵人致盲。
hiddenEn: Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown, Blinding enemies Hit.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續性的增益技能，使你在該技能啟動期間，可以透過擊殺敵人恢復生命。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to recover Life on kill while the Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 增益效果, 持續
輔助持續增益效果的技能，使你在該技能啟動期間，可以透過擊殺敵人恢復生命。
hiddenEn: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to recover Life on kill while the Skill is active.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 重擊
輔助由自身使用的重擊，賦予它們製造一道餘震的機率。
hiddenEn: Supports Slams you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an Aftershock.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 重擊
輔助由自身使用的重擊，賦予它們製造一道餘震的機率。
hiddenEn: Supports Slams you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an Aftershock.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 近戰, 重擊
輔助重擊技能。被輔助的技能有一定機率造成餘震，且其攻擊的時間越長，造成餘震的機率便會提高。
hiddenEn: Supports Slam Skills. Supported Skills a chance to create an Aftershock as well as increased chance to cause Aftershocks the longer their Attack time

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 範圍效果, 近戰, 觸發, 物理
輔助,攻擊,範圍效果,近戰,觸發,物理
輔助近戰攻擊技能。被輔助的技能會觸發驟羽爆發，對被擊中目標周圍區域造成你的荊棘傷害。驟羽爆發只能在你以反擊造成荊棘傷害後，於擊中時觸發。
hiddenEn: Support, Attack, AoE, Melee, Trigger, Physical
Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills trigger Quill Burst, which deals your Thorns Damage in an Area around the target struck. Quill Burst can only be triggered on Hit after you've

hiddenZh: 輔助, 範圍效果, 觸發, 物理
輔助,範圍效果,觸發,物理
輔助擊中敵人的技能。被輔助的技能擊殺釘身敵人時會觸發骨片爆炸。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies. Supported Skills trigger Bone Shrapnel explosions when killing Pinned Enemies.

hiddenZh: 輔助奉獻技能。被輔助的技能的增益效果提高，且造成更多傷害，但是在施放時會額外瞄準一個骷髏召喚物。如果沒有額外的骷髏召喚物可供瞄準，就不會賦予傷害或增益效果。
hiddenEn: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills have increased Buff effect and deal more damage, but will target an additional skeletal Minion when cast. If there is not an additional skeletal Minion to target, no damage or Buff effect will be granted.

hiddenZh: 輔助奉獻技能，使你的可爆發法術爆發至奉獻周圍的區域。
hiddenEn: Supports Offering Skills, causing your Cascadable Spells to Cascade to the locations of Supported Offerings.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，在撲殺敵人時恢復魔力。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Mana when it Culls an enemy.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 物理
輔助攻擊，使其物理傷害偷取魔力。
hiddenEn: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Mana.

hiddenZh: 輔助創造圖騰的技能。由被輔助的技能創造的圖騰會生成一個魔力之泉，為身處其中的友方偷取魔力。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Mana which will Leech Mana to Allies within it.

hiddenZh: 輔助會擊中敵人的技能，使其擊殺的敵人賦予更多的魔力藥劑充能。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it kills to grant more Mana Flask charges.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 法術, 範圍效果, 觸發, 火焰
輔助,法術,範圍效果,觸發,火焰
輔助任何會擊中敵人的法術，使其暴擊觸發魔力閃焰。魔力閃焰會消耗你的魔力並造成火焰傷害。無法輔助召喚物的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports any Spell that Hits enemies, causing it to trigger a Mana Flare on Critical Hit. The Mana Flare consumes your Mana to deal Fire damage. Cannot support the skills of Minions.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 族裔, 風暴
輔助風暴技能，增加其上限，並使其從使用者快速移動至目標位置，但效果降低。無法輔助觸發技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Storm skills, increasing their Limit and causing them to move quickly from the user to the target location, but become less effective. Cannot Support Triggered Skills.

hiddenZh: 輔助創造圖騰的技能。由被輔助的技能創造的圖騰會生成一個鮮血之泉，為身處其中的友方偷取生命。
hiddenEn: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Blood which will Leech Life to Allies within it.

hiddenZh: 輔助擲彈技能。被輔助的技能之擲彈不會彈跳，而是直接停在最初落地的位置，並在引爆時造成較低的傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land, but doing lower damage when they detonate.

hiddenZh: 輔助擲彈技能。被輔助的技能之擲彈不會彈跳，而是直接停在最初落地的位置。
hiddenEn: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land.

hiddenZh: 輔助擲彈技能。被輔助的技能之擲彈不會彈跳，而是直接停在最初落地的位置。被輔助的技能的擲彈冷卻較長，且有機會額外引爆一次。
hiddenEn: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land. Grenades from Supported Skills have longer cooldowns, and a chance to detonate an additional time.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何擊中敵人的技能，使其更容易施加點燃。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何擊中敵人的技能，使其更容易施加點燃。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite.

hiddenZh: 輔助任何會擊中敵人的技能，使其更容易點燃並使造成的點燃更快造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite and causing inflicted Ignites to deal their damage more quickly.

hiddenZh: 輔助, 攻擊, 投射物
輔助由由自身使用、會發射投射物的攻擊技能，使其隨時間獲得封印。使用時會破除封印，使其發射額外投射物。被輔助的技能的投射物會朝隨機方向發射。無法輔助需要連擊、具有冷卻時間或已會獲得封印的技能。
hiddenEn: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which fire Projectiles, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when used, causing additional Projectiles to be fired. Projectiles from Supported Skills are fired in random directions. Cannot Support Skills which require Combo, have a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 閃電, 冰冷, 火焰
增益效果,持續,閃電,冰冷,火焰
與所有元素同調，並根據你擊中所造成的最高元素傷害類型來累積火焰、冰冷和閃電親和。你任一類型的親和越高，造成的元素傷害便會強化。
hiddenEn: Become attuned to all Elements building up Fire, Cold and Lightning Affinity based off the highest Elemental Damage type dealt by your Hits. Your Elemental Damage is enhanced the more Affinity of any type you have.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 光環, 混沌
增益效果,持續,光環,混沌
施放一個光環，使你和你存在範圍內的友方獲得混沌抗性。
hiddenEn: Emit an Aura that boosts the Chaos Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 主要
召喚物,增益效果,持續,觸發,主要
啟動期間，一隻九頭蛇盟友會附著於你的身體，每隔一段時間向周圍感電、冰凍及點燃的敵人施放插槽中的投射物法術。
hiddenEn: While active, a companion Hydra will rear up from your body and regularly cast socketed Projectile Spells at nearby Shocked, Frozen, and Ignited enemies.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 主要
增益效果,持續,觸發,主要
啟動時，當你的其中一個護符被使用時會獲得能量，並在到達最大能量時觸發插槽中的法術。
hiddenEn: While active, gains Energy when one of your Charms is used and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 閃電, 冰冷, 火焰, 持續時間
增益效果,持續,閃電,冰冷,火焰,持續時間
操控一股原始且無法預測的元素之力，使你造成的隨機一種元素傷害大幅提高。受影響的元素會頻繁地改變，但同樣的元素可以被連續影響多次。
hiddenEn: Buff, Persistent, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration

Tap into a current of raw and unpredictable Elemental power, causing you to deal greatly more damage of a randomly chosen Element. The Element affected changes frequently, though the same Element can be affected multiple times in succession.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 閃電, 冰冷, 火焰, 主要
增益效果,持續,觸發,閃電,冰冷,火焰,主要
啟動期間，當你對敵人造成冰凍、感電或點燃時獲得能量，並在到達最大能量時觸發插槽中的法術。
hiddenEn: Buff, Persistent, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Meta
While active, gains Energy when you Freeze, Shock, or Ignite enemies, and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 閃電, 冰冷, 火焰, 祈願, 主要
增益效果,持續,觸發,閃電,冰冷,火焰,祈願,主要
啟動時，當你冰凍、感電或點燃一名敵人，便會獲得能量。收集到足夠的能量後使用祈願，將會消耗能量以觸發插槽中的法術，若有足夠的能量則可以觸發多次。
hiddenEn: Buff, Persistent, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Invocation, Meta

While active, gains Energy when you Freeze, Shock or Ignite an enemy. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.

hiddenZh: 啟動時，你會根據生效的能量球獲得強力的增益效果。然而，維持增益效果需每隔幾秒消耗能量球。
hiddenEn: While active, you gain powerful Buffs based on your active Charges. However, maintaining the Buff Consumes Charges every few seconds.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 持續, 號令, 持續時間
召喚物,持續,號令,持續時間
利用克拉里的力量以被動的消耗存在內的屍體，使覆葬甲蟲召喚物迸發而出。這些甲蟲會被動地跟隨你，直到你下號令。當收到你的號令時，它們會衝刺至目標並爆炸。
hiddenEn: Harness Kelari's power to passively Consume Corpses in your Presence, causing Corpse Beetle Minions to burst forth. The Beetles passively follow you until Commanded. On your Command, they rush the target and explode.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 攻擊, 持續, 範圍效果, 冰冷
增益效果,攻擊,持續,範圍效果,冰冷
當你以空手近戰攻擊擊中時，射出一發會對周遭敵人造成空手攻擊傷害的冰冷之風。
hiddenEn: When you Hit with Unarmed Melee Attacks, projects icy wind which deal Unarmed Attack damage to all surrounding enemies and destroy Ice Crystals.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 冰冷, 主要
增益效果,持續,觸發,冰冷,主要
啟動期間，當你冰凍敵人時獲得能量，並在到達最大能量時觸發插槽中的法術。
hiddenEn: While active, gains Energy when you Freeze enemies and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

hiddenZh: 法術, 增益效果, 持續, 光環, 冰冷
法術,增益效果,持續,光環,冰冷
對你存在範圍內的所有敵人施加冰緩。
hiddenEn: Chills all enemies in your Presence.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 攻擊, 持續, 範圍效果, 冰冷, 捷光環, 遣散
增益效果,攻擊,持續,範圍效果,冰冷,捷光環,遣散
啟動時，以非捷光環攻擊擊中並粉碎敵人會引發冰霜爆炸，並對周圍敵人造成攻擊傷害。
hiddenEn: Buff, Attack, Persistent, AoE, Cold, Herald, Payoff
While active, Shattering an enemy with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause an icy explosion that deals Attack damage to surrounding enemies.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 光環, 冰冷
增益效果,持續,光環,冰冷
施放一個光環，使你和你存在範圍內的友方獲得冰冷抗性。
hiddenEn: Emit an Aura that boosts the Cold Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 法術, 召喚物, 持續, 痕跡
增益效果,法術,召喚物,持續,痕跡
啟動時，你的復甦召喚物會儲存其最大生命的一部分，在死亡時成為可收集的殘酷痕跡。使用冷酷復活會消耗你收集的生命來復甦相當於該生命總量的死亡召喚物。
hiddenEn: While active, your Reviving Minions store a percentage of their maximum Life in a collectible Grim Remnant on death. Using Grim Resurrection Consumes the Life you've collected to Revive up to that much total Life of dead Minions.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 光環, 混沌, 持續時間
增益效果,持續,光環,混沌,持續時間
啟動時，產生一個光環，週期性使你存在範圍內的敵人凋零。
hiddenEn: While active, emits an Aura that periodically Withers enemies in your Presence.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 光環, 閃電
增益效果,持續,光環,閃電
啟動時，任何技能首次擊中一名你存在範圍內的感電敵人時，該技能也會擊中你存在範圍內的其他感電敵人，同時擊中的敵人有其最大值。
hiddenEn: While active, the first time any Skill Hits a Shocked enemy in your Presence, that Skill also Hits other Shocked enemies in your Presence, up to a maximum.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 範圍效果, 冰冷, 持續時間
增益效果,持續,範圍效果,冰冷,持續時間
啟動時，使用其他技能造成暴擊擊中並擊殺目標，或對強大目標造成暴擊擊中時，會使你獲得極地花瓣。一旦擁有足夠的極地花瓣，它們將被消耗，並在最近一個目標附近創造冰晶。
hiddenEn: While active, Critical Hits with other skills that kill targets, or hit powerful targets cause you to gain Arctic Petals. Once you have enough Arctic Petals they will be Consumed to create Ice Crystals near the most recent target.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 痕跡
啟動時，你暈眩或擊殺的敵人有機率生成符文保護痕跡。這些痕跡可以溢出你的符文保護。
hiddenEn: While active, enemies you Stun or kill have a chance to generate a Runic Ward Remnant. These Remnants can Overflow your Runic Ward.

hiddenZh: 鬥旗, 增益效果, 持續, 範圍效果, 光環, 持續時間, 條件
鬥旗,增益效果,持續,範圍效果,光環,持續時間,條件
啟動時，攻擊敵人會累積榮耀。當你擁有最大榮耀，你就能放置一面帶有光環的激勵鬥旗，在鬥旗持續期間賦予你和附近的友方護甲值、閃避和移動速度。
hiddenEn: Banner, Buff, Persistent, AoE, Aura, Duration, Conditional

While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Armour, Evasion and movement speed.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 主要
增益效果,持續,觸發,主要
啟動期間，當你受到傷害時獲得能量，並在到達最大能量時觸發插槽中的法術。
hiddenEn: While active, gains Energy when you take damage and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 盟友, 持續, 物理
召喚出一群惡狼盟友。狼群在計算會盟友上限時僅會消耗一格盟友欄位，不論狼群中狼的數量為何。
hiddenEn: Activate to summon a pack of Wolf Companions. The pack treated as a single Companion for effects that count or limit Companions, regardless of the number of Wolves in the pack.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 召喚物, 持續, 觸發, 主要
增益效果,召喚物,持續,觸發,主要
啟動期間，你的持續召喚物被擊殺時會使你獲得能量，並在到達最大能量時觸發插槽中的法術。等級非常落後的召喚物具有一個能量產生懲罰。無法插入創造召喚物的法術。
hiddenEn: While active, gains Energy when one of your Persistent Minions is Killed, and triggers socketed Spells upon reaching maximum Energy. Very underlevelled Minions will incur an Energy generation penalty. Cannot socket Spells which create Minions.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 盟友, 持續, 火焰
啟動以召喚一頭復甦獄炎獵犬，點燃其附近的敵人。
hiddenEn: Activate to summon a Reviving Infernal Hound which Ignites enemies near it.

hiddenZh: 攻擊, 召喚物, 盟友, 持續, 彈藥, 主要
攻擊,召喚物,盟友,持續,彈藥,主要
召喚一名復甦傭兵協助你進行戰鬥。傭兵會使用鑲嵌的攻擊，並可經由技能選單為傭兵配置裝備。
hiddenEn: Attack, Minion, Companion, Persistent, Ammunition, Meta
Summon a Reviving Companion to aid you in combat. The Mercenary will use socketed Attacks, and can be given equipment in the Skills Panel.

hiddenZh: 啟動時會間歇性的創造自身行動的有益平行時間線。這些時間線中的你會使用你第一組可用的武器組合所能使用的一種法術。在下一道時間線幻影出現前，施放和該時間線的你所用的相同法術會使命運同調，並強化該法術。幻影僅能施放傷害性、非引導、非增益且你可以施放的無冷卻時間法術。
hiddenEn: While active, visages of yourself from alternate timelines will occasionally appear and cast one of your Spells from your first valid Weapon Set. Until the next visage appears, your next cast of the same Spell aligns your fate, Empowering that Spell. Visages can only cast damaging, non-Channelling, non-Buff Spells you could cast that have no cooldown.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 範圍效果, 持續時間
增益效果,持續,範圍效果,持續時間
啟動時，定期在你附近顯現強烈符文能量的區域。站在其上會給予你強大的法術傷害加成，但會持續消耗你的符文保護。符文保護耗盡時，能量將會消散。
hiddenEn: While active, areas of intense runic energy are revealed to you. Standing over them grants you a powerful Spell damage boost but constantly drains your Runic Ward. Running out of Runic Ward causes the energy to temporarily dissipate.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 光環
啟動時，產生一個光環，使你存在範圍內的敵人更容易被暈眩和造成元素異常狀態。
hiddenEn: While active, emits an Aura that makes enemies in your Presence easier to Stun and inflict Elemental Ailments upon.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 閃電
啟動時，使你的非引導法術消耗額外的魔力，並造成額外的閃電傷害，兩者皆根據你的最大魔力而定。
hiddenEn: While active, causes your Non-Channelling Spells to cost additional mana and deal extra Lightning damage, both based on your maximum Mana.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 攻擊, 持續, 範圍效果, 物理
增益效果,攻擊,持續,範圍效果,物理
啟動時，衝刺會使你成為一陣蝗蟲群，在你周遭的區域內造成不基於武器傷害的物理攻擊傷害。若此擊中任何目標，你會承受傷害並累積沉重暈眩，但你衝刺期間不會受到來自其他來源的沉重暈眩累積或被中斷衝刺。
hiddenEn: While active, Sprinting turns you into a locust swarm which deals Physical Attack damage, which is not based on your Weapon's damage, in an area around you. You take damage and gain Heavy Stun buildup if this Hits any targets, but damage you take from other sources while sprinting will not apply Heavy Stun or interrupt your sprinting.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 攻擊, 持續, 範圍效果, 物理, 捷光環, 遣散
增益效果,攻擊,持續,範圍效果,物理,捷光環,遣散
以失血擊殺一名敵人時會使其血腥的爆炸，對周遭敵人造成物理攻擊傷害。此攻擊不基於你的武器傷害，而是基於目標累積的失血。爆炸會視同敵人為普通或魔法般摧毀其屍體。
hiddenEn: Buff, Attack, Persistent, AoE, Physical, Herald, Payoff

Killing an enemy with Blood Loss will cause a bloody explosion that deals Physical Attack damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your Weapon Damage, but is based on their accumulated Blood Loss. The explosion destroys their Corpse if the enemy was Normal or Magic.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 盟友, 持續, 物理
啟動以召喚一群奸笑的鬣狗盟友。鬣狗群在計算盟友上限時會被視為單一的盟友，無論該群中的鬣狗數量。鬣狗們在初次現身時會叫喊，阻礙周遭的敵人，且有機率癱瘓牠們擊中的敵人。
hiddenEn: Activate to summon a cackle of Hyena Companions. The cackle is treated as a single Companion for effects that count or limit Companions, regardless of the number of Hyenas in the cackle. Hyenas whoop when they first appear, Hindering nearby enemies, and have a chance to Maim enemies they Hit.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 祈願, 主要
增益效果,持續,觸發,祈願,主要
啟動時，當你的能量護盾承受到敵人的擊中傷害，便會獲得能量。收集到足夠的能量後使用祈願，將會消耗能量以觸發插槽中的法術，若有足夠的能量則可以觸發多次。
hiddenEn: While active, gains Energy when your Energy Shield is damaged by Enemy Hits. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.

hiddenZh: 法術, 增益效果, 持續, 閃電, 冰冷, 火焰
法術,增益效果,持續,閃電,冰冷,火焰
被動地幻化出一道防護屏障，在耗盡之前可為你承受來自擊中的元素傷害。若你停止承受傷害或是完全耗盡了屏障，屏障會在短暫延遲後立即恢復到滿溢狀態。
hiddenEn: Spell, Buff, Persistent, Lightning, Cold, Fire

Passively manifests a protective barrier which takes Elemental Damage from Hits for you until depleted. The barrier instantly recharges to its full value a short time after it stops taking damage or is fully depleted.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 盟友, 持續
幻化出一個你主手近戰軍用武器的複製體，讓它成為不朽盟友與你並肩作戰。除了標準的打擊之外，幻化武器會根據其武器類型獲得一種額外的攻擊。
hiddenEn: Manifest a copy of your main hand Melee Martial Weapon as an immortal Companion to fight by your side. In addition to its standard Strikes, the Manifested Weapon gains an additional Attack depending on its weapon type.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 持續時間, 主要
增益效果,持續,觸發,持續時間,主要
啟動時，閃避翻滾會產生一個幻影之體，在短時間內使用插槽中的遠程攻擊，之後消失。
hiddenEn: While active, dodge rolling will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged Attacks for a short duration, then vanish.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 持續時間, 主要
增益效果,持續,觸發,持續時間,主要
啟動時，發射遠程投射物攻擊會創造一道使用插槽中遠程攻擊的幻影，並在持續短暫時間後消失。
hiddenEn: While active, firing a ranged Projectile Attack will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged Attacks for a short duration, then vanish.

hiddenZh: 法術, 增益效果, 持續
在一小段時間未使用技能或受到攻擊後，獲得匿蹤。
hiddenEn: Gain Stealth after not using Skills or being Hit for a short time.

hiddenZh: 召喚被束縛的怪物的靈魂作為復甦的召喚物。
hiddenEn: Summon the spirit of the bound monster as a Reviving Minion.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 主要
增益效果,持續,觸發,主要
啟動期間，當你引導法術時獲得能量，並在到達最大能量時觸發插槽中的法術。
hiddenEn: While active, gains Energy while you're channelling a skill and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 增益效果, 盟友, 持續
召喚物,增益效果,盟友,持續
使用弓或長矛時，駕馭一隻可騎乘的恐喙鳥盟友。騎乘時，你可以使用弓、投擲長矛和印記技能，且使用技能時的減速程度降低，但你遭擊中時會累積沉重暈眩。未騎乘時，恐喙鳥會用其嘴喙來攻擊敵人，但能夠受到傷害。
hiddenEn: Harnesses a Companion Rhoa you can mount while you're wielding a Bow or Spear. While mounted you can use Bow, thrown Spear, and Mark Skills, and are much less slowed while using Skills, but being Hit will cause Heavy Stun buildup. While you aren't mounted, the Rhoa will attack your enemies alongside you with its beak, but can be damaged.

hiddenZh: 鬥旗, 增益效果, 持續, 範圍效果, 光環, 持續時間, 條件
鬥旗,增益效果,持續,範圍效果,光環,持續時間,條件
啟動時，攻擊敵人會累積榮耀。當你擁有最大榮耀，你就能放置一面帶有光環的激勵鬥旗，在鬥旗持續期間賦予你和附近的友方元素異常狀態門檻、最大元素抗性和藥劑充能。
hiddenEn: Banner, Buff, Persistent, AoE, Aura, Duration, Conditional

While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Elemental Ailment Threshold, Maximum Elemental Resistances and Flask charges.

hiddenZh: 法術, 增益效果, 持續, 持續時間
法術,增益效果,持續,持續時間
生效時賦予你一個技能，使用後可立即開始充能能量護盾，並獲得一個持續一段時間的增益效果，使充能不會遭到中斷。該增益效果在能量護盾達到最大時移除，且該技能在能量護盾已滿時無法使用。
hiddenEn: While active, grants a skill that you can use to instantly begin Recharging Energy Shield and gain a Buff for a duration that prevents that Recharge being interrupted. The Buff is removed at maximum Energy Shield and the skill cannot be used while Energy Shield is full.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 盟友, 持續, 主要
啟動以召喚一個復甦惡魔瑪格思，其依順序施展插槽中的法術。
hiddenEn: Activate to summon a Reviving Demon Magus which casts socketed Spells in order.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 閃電, 主要
增益效果,持續,觸發,閃電,主要
啟動時，當你電擊敵人時獲得能量，並在到達最大能量時觸發插槽中的法術。
hiddenEn: While active, gains Energy when you Shock enemies and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 召喚物, 持續, 火焰, 持續時間
增益效果,召喚物,持續,火焰,持續時間
啟動期間，你自己施放的火焰法術也會召喚憤怒狂靈，這種持續時間短暫的火焰骷髏會衝向附近的敵人並快速攻擊，但會無視號令。敵人不會直接與這些召喚物交戰，並可穿過他們。
hiddenEn: While active, Fire Spells you use yourself will also summon Raging Spirits, which are short-lived flaming skulls that rush at nearby enemies and rapidly Attack them, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them.

hiddenZh: 鬥旗, 增益效果, 持續, 範圍效果, 光環, 持續時間, 條件

啟動時，攻擊敵人會累積榮耀。當你擁有最大榮耀，你就能放置一面帶有光環的激勵鬥旗，在鬥旗持續期間賦予你和附近的友方攻擊傷害、攻擊速度及命中。

While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Attack damage, Attack speed and Accuracy.

hiddenZh: 啟動時，當你冰凍、觸電或釘身一名敵人時，賦予你一顆狂怒球。此效果每幾秒只能觸發一次。
hiddenEn: While active, grants you a Frenzy Charge when you Freeze, Electrocute or Pin an enemy. This can only occur once every few seconds.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 祈願, 主要
增益效果,持續,觸發,祈願,主要
輔助沒有保留的法術技能。不能輔助被圖騰、陷阱或地雷使用的技能。不能調整召喚物技能。
啟動時，當你施展法術，便會獲得能量。收集到足夠的能量後使用祈願，將會消耗能量以觸發插槽中的法術，若有足夠的能量則可以觸發多次。
hiddenEn: While active, gains Energy when you cast Spells. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 物理, 持續時間
增益效果,持續,物理,持續時間
啟動時，使用自敵人收集而來的護甲碎片加強自己的護甲。完全破壞敵人的護甲時，會依據其稀有度賦予你數層的拾荒者護板，持續一段時間，每層使你獲得護甲值和荊棘。普通敵人賦予 1 層、魔法敵人賦予 2 層、稀有敵人賦予 5 層，而傳奇敵人賦予 10 層。
hiddenEn: While active, uses fragments of armour scavenged from enemies to bolster your own. Fully Breaking an enemy's Armour grants you stacks of Scavenged Plating for a duration based on the enemy's Rarity, and you gain Armour and Thorns per stack. Normal enemies grant 1 stack, Magic enemies grant 2 stacks, Rare enemies grant 5 stacks and Unique enemies grant 10 stacks.

hiddenZh: 啟動時，你與稀有和傳奇敵人交戰的時間越久，對其造成的擊中傷害越高，且與其交戰足夠久之後，獲得撲殺效果。
hiddenEn: While active, causes you to deal more Hit damage to Rare and Unique enemies the longer you've been fighting them, and gain Culling Strike against them once you've been fighting them for long enough.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 火焰, 主要
增益效果,持續,觸發,火焰,主要
啟動時，當你以近戰攻擊擊中敵人時獲得能量，並在到達最大能量時觸發插槽中的火焰法術。
hiddenEn: While active, gains Energy when you Hit enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed Fire spells on reaching maximum Energy.

hiddenZh: 招募會在你後方就定位的砲火召喚物。他們會等待你的號令，隨後朝目標位置發射無數的箭矢。
hiddenEn: Recruit artillery Minions that take up positions behind you. They will lie in wait for your Command, then fire volleys of arrows at the target location.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 祈願, 主要
增益效果,持續,觸發,祈願,主要
啟動時，當你以近戰攻擊擊殺一名敵人，會獲得能量。收集到足夠的能量後使用祈願，將會消耗能量以觸發插槽中的法術，若有足夠的能量則可以觸發多次。
hiddenEn: While active, gains Energy when you kill an enemy with a Melee Attack. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.

hiddenZh: 法術, 增益效果, 持續
啟動時，被動地留下你最近的過往殘影。施放法術時以返回至最舊的殘影處，將你傳送到該位置並使你的生命、魔力和能量護盾重置為當時的值。在使用時移除所有由迷蹤形態延遲、且即將到來的傷害。
hiddenEn: While active, passively leaves afterimages of your recent past. Cast the Spell to return to the oldest afterimage, teleporting to that location and resetting your Life, Mana and Energy Shield to the values they had at the time. Removes any upcoming damage delayed by Phased Form on use.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 主要
增益效果,持續,觸發,主要
啟動期間，當你遭擊暈時獲得能量，並在到達最大能量時觸發插槽中的法術。
hiddenEn: While active, gains Energy when you are Stunned and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 主要
增益效果,持續,觸發,主要
啟動時，當你暴擊敵人時獲得能量，並在到達最大能量時觸發插槽中的法術。
hiddenEn: While active, gains Energy when you Critically Hit enemies and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 持續, 號令, 冰冷
召喚納維拉，一名聽從你的號令的無敵水之巨靈召喚物。納維拉僅會在你對她發出號令時行動，以法術為你和你的友方降下恢復性的賜福。
hiddenEn: Summon Navira, an invulnerable Water Djinn Minion to do your bidding. Navira will only act when you Command her to do so, bestowing restorative blessings upon you and your Allies with her Spells.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 持續時間
增益效果,持續,持續時間
啟動時，以能量護盾承受來自敵人的擊中傷害時會使你短暫獲得護甲。從複數擊中獲得的護甲可以堆疊。從此技能獲得的總護甲無法超過裝備護甲的物品護甲值。
hiddenEn: While active, taking Hit damage from enemies to your Energy Shield causes you to gain Armour for a short duration. Armour gained from multiple Hits can stack. The total Armour gained from this Skill cannot exceed the Item Armour on your Equipped Armour Items.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 持續時間
增益效果,持續,持續時間
悉妮蔻拉洞悉你的未來昔日，給予你轉換悲慘命運的機會。在經過一段時間的後事之師後，她會賦予你洞燭機先，讓你在翻滾閃避的時候避免遭擊中。當你在翻滾閃避時遭擊中，悉妮蔻拉讓你在承受擊中傷害前立即恢復至最大生命，並賦予你超越境界，使你不會死亡。
hiddenEn: Hinekora observes your Future-Past granting you the opportunity to subvert a lesser fate. After a period of Hindsight, she will grant you her Foresight, which prevents you from avoiding Hits while Dodge Rolling. When you are Hit while Dodge Rolling, Hinekora restores you to full Life immediately before taking damage from the Hit, and grants you Sight Beyond Sight, which prevents you from dying.

hiddenZh: 捕捉遭擊敗怪物的靈魂，將這顆寶石轉變為允許你將怪物的鬼魂召喚為復甦召喚物。
hiddenEn: Capture the spirit of a defeated monster, transforming this gem to instead allow you to summon the monster's ghost as a Reviving Minion.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 主要
增益效果,持續,觸發,主要
啟動時，當你格擋時獲得能量，並在到達最大能量時觸發插槽中的法術。
hiddenEn: While active, gains Energy when you Block and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 主要
增益效果,持續,觸發,主要
啟動時，當你格擋時獲得能量，並在到達最大能量時觸發插槽中的詛咒。
hiddenEn: While active, gains Energy when you Block and triggers socketed Curses on reaching maximum Energy.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 法術, 持續, 持續性, 冰冷, 獲得疊層
增益效果,法術,持續,持續性,冰冷,獲得疊層
啟動時，召喚一道會隨時間增強的寒冰屏障。當屏障處於增強階段時，擊中你的近戰攻擊會移除一個階段，引發冰霜爆發，對攻擊者造成冰冷法術傷害。
hiddenEn: Buff, Spell, Persistent, Sustained, Cold, Staged

While active, conjures an icy barrier that gains stages over time. While the barrier has stages, Melee Attacks that hit you will remove a stage to cause a burst of ice that deals Cold Spell damage to the attacker.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 主要
增益效果,持續,觸發,主要
增益效果, 持續, 持續時間
增益效果,持續,持續時間
啟動時，你攻擊敵人時會累積怒氣。使用此技能時會釋放你的狂怒並使你進入野獸般的瘋狂狀態，獲得傷害和猛攻 但會持續失去生命且會強制你處於動物型態。狂怒狀態會在你回到人類型態時立即結束。你無法在狂怒狀態期間獲得怒氣。
hiddenEn: While active, your Fury builds from Attacking enemies. Using this Skill releases your Fury to send you into a bestial frenzy, gaining damage and Onslaught but constantly losing life and forcing you into animal form. The frenzy ends immediately if you return to human form. You cannot gain Fury while in a frenzy.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 持續時間, 痕跡
增益效果,持續,持續時間,痕跡
啟動時，每當你閃避翻滾，會創造出一個自己的幻影分身，持續一小段時間。該分身可由敵人造成傷害，並在遭敵人摧毀時給你一個暴擊球。
hiddenEn: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will drop a Remnant that grants you a Power Charge on pickup.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 範圍效果, 光環, 主要
增益效果,持續,範圍效果,光環,主要
將所有插槽中的詛咒技能轉變為惡毒光環，將效果套用於周圍所有敵人。
hiddenEn: Turn socketed Curse skills into vile Auras, applying their effects to all nearby enemies.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 光環, 火焰
增益效果,持續,光環,火焰
施放一個光環，使你和你存在範圍內的友方獲得火焰抗性。
hiddenEn: Emit an Aura that boosts the Fire Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 範圍效果, 物理, 火焰, 引爆器, 快行
增益效果,持續,範圍效果,物理,火焰,引爆器,快行
將閃避翻滾替換為爆炸輔助的跳躍，從義腿的火砲射出一發砲彈，對你所逃離區域內的敵人施加致盲和點燃。該爆炸也會使效果範圍內的任何擲彈一起爆炸。
hiddenEn: Buff, Persistent, AoE, Physical, Fire, Detonator, Travel

Replaces your dodge roll with an explosive-assisted leap, firing off a round from your prosthetic cannon leg that Blinds and Ignites enemies in the area you escape from. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 範圍效果, 火焰, 持續時間, 捷光環
增益效果,持續,範圍效果,火焰,持續時間,捷光環
啟動時，以非捷光環攻擊對敵人造成足夠的溢出傷害時會引發爆炸，並根據溢出的傷害對附近的敵人施加點燃。
hiddenEn: Buff, Persistent, AoE, Fire, Duration, Herald
While active, enemies you sufficiently Overkill with non-Herald Attacks will cause an explosion that Ignites nearby enemies based on the Overkill damage dealt.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 光環
啟動時，被動給予你藥劑使用次數，並使你藥劑的生命和魔力恢復也會套用在你存在範圍內的友方身上。
hiddenEn: While active, grants you Flask charges passively and causes Life and Mana recovery from your Flasks to also apply to Allies in your Presence.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 攻擊, 持續, 範圍效果, 近戰, 觸發, 火焰

hiddenZh: 啟動時，加強你的盛怒，但會使你失去生命而不會失去盛怒。
hiddenEn: While active, strengthens your Rage, but causes you to lose Life while not losing Rage.

啟動時，你的不死復甦召喚物可以用來替代你的技能所使用的屍體，但你的召喚物復甦速度減慢。
hiddenEn: While active, your undead Reviving Minions can be used in place of Corpses by your skills, but your Minions Revive more slowly.

hiddenEn: Drink the blood of your enemies to restore your Life. While active, enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Life Remnant, and Hitting a target spawns a Life Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Life Remnant grants you Life which can Overflow maximum Life.

hiddenEn: While active, killing a Poisoned enemy spreads its Poison to other nearby enemies, and has a chance to also Hinder them.

召喚一個能在戰鬥中協助你的復甦野獸盟友。
hiddenEn: Summon a Reviving Beast Companion to aid you in combat.

hiddenEn: Draws out the latent fears of enemies you kill and Rare or Unique enemies you Hit, turning them into unstable apparitions which charge towards enemies and then explode.

Your Hits immediately destroy the bells, creating a shockwave that damages nearby enemies and causes a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. The bells are themselves always Primed for Stun, they can be Culled, and Hits against them are always Critical Hits.

hiddenEn: Conjure hateful energy to fuel your Rage and Life. While active, Bleeding enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Hateful Remnant, and Hitting a Bleeding target spawns a Hateful Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Hateful Remnant grants you Rage and recovers Life based on your current Rage.

hiddenEn: Call upon a Bear Spirit Companion to maul your foes. The Bear Spirit leaps at enemies to Maim them, Leeches Life with its slam, and periodically roars to Intimidate enemies. The Bear Spirit does not count toward your Companion limit.

啟動時，週期性地賦予多層增益效果，每層增益效果使你獲得更多閃避值。在此增益效果期間遭敵人擊中時會消耗所有層數，對周圍敵人造成傷害並將其擊退。
hiddenEn: Buff, Attack, Persistent, AoE, Melee, Trigger, Staged

While active, periodically grants stages of a buff that gives you more Evasion per stage. Being Hit by an Enemy while you have this buff consumes all stages to damage and Knock Back enemies around you.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 盟友, 持續, 持續時間
召喚物,盟友,持續,持續時間
召喚阿茲莫里妖精，在一段時間內吞噬稀有野獸，並阻礙牠們。當你在野獸被妖精吞噬時將其擊敗，牠將會被這顆寶石捕獲，將寶石轉變為允許你將野獸召喚為復甦盟友。
hiddenEn: Conjure Azmeri wisps to engulf a Rare Beast for a duration, Hindering them. If you defeat the Beast while it is engulfed in wisps, it will be captured by this gem, transforming the gem to instead allow you to summon the Beast as a Reviving Companion.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 戰吼, 持續, 物理, 遣散
召喚物,戰吼,持續,物理,遣散
啟動以召喚力量超群的復甦骷髏蠻兵，其可以暈眩可暈眩的敵人，可經由號令施放戰吼。該戰吼會威嚇附近敵人，並消耗敵人身上的冰凍來對其周圍區域造成傷害。
hiddenEn: Activate to summon hard-hitting, Reviving Skeletal Brutes that can Stun Primed enemies and Warcry on Command. This Warcry Intimidates nearby enemies and Consumes Freeze on enemies and allies to deal damage in an Area around them.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 持續, 物理
啟動以召喚復甦的骷髏戰士。
hiddenEn: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Warriors.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 持續, 物理
啟動以召喚積極攻擊的復甦骷髏掠奪者，可經由號令將其激怒。骷髏掠奪者會根據他們的盛怒造成更多攻擊傷害並增加攻擊速度。
hiddenEn: Activate to summon aggressive, Reviving Skeletal Reavers that can enrage on Command. Skeletal Reavers do more Attack Damage and gain increased Attack speed based on their Rage

hiddenZh: 啟動以召喚復甦骷髏牧師，其可治療其他召喚物並復甦陣亡的骷髏。
hiddenEn: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Clerics that heal other minions and revive fallen Skeletons.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 持續, 物理, 火焰, 混沌
召喚物,持續,物理,火焰,混沌
啟動以召喚遠距離攻擊的復甦骷髏狙擊手，可經由號令命其發射毒氣箭矢。
hiddenEn: Activate to summon long-ranged, Reviving Skeletal Snipers that can fire a gas arrow on Command.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 持續, 火焰, 引爆器
召喚物,持續,火焰,引爆器
啟動以召喚投擲炸彈的復甦骷髏縱火者，可經由號令命其引爆其他召喚物。
hiddenEn: Activate to summon bomb-throwing, Reviving Skeletal Arsonists that can detonate other Minions on Command.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 持續, 冰冷
啟動以召喚復甦骷髏寒霜法師，其可經由號令為你的召喚物施加冰霜護盾。
hiddenEn: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Frost Mages that can envelop your Minions in an icy shield on Command.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 持續, 閃電
啟動以召喚復甦的骷髏風暴法師，可經由號令命其對陣亡的骷髏所在處施放閃電風暴。
hiddenEn: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Storm Mages that can call down a lightning strike on dead Skeletons on Command.

hiddenZh: 啟動時，召喚一道閃耀屏障，隨時間積累每種屬性類型的保護寶石碎片，但每次受到擊中時會失去一個隨機碎片。
hiddenEn: While active, conjures a glittering barrier that accumulates protective gemstone Motes of each Attribute type over time, but loses a random Mote when you are Hit.

hiddenZh: 啟動時，使你週期性地獲得幽魂屍布。當你擁有幽魂屍布又受到擊中時，會立刻消耗一層幽魂屍布，並根據你的閃避值恢復能量護盾。
hiddenEn: While active, causes you to periodically gain Ghost Shrouds. If you are Hit while you have a Ghost Shroud, it is immediately consumed to recover Energy Shield based on your Evasion.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 痕跡
召喚奧術能量來回復自己的魔力。啟動時，你所擊殺的受元素異常狀態影響之敵人有一定機率生成一個魔力痕跡，對受元素異常狀態影響之目標造成暴擊則每隔數秒生成一個魔力痕跡。拾起一個魔力痕跡會賦予你魔力，可溢出最大魔力。
hiddenEn: Conjure surging arcane energy to restore your Mana. While active, enemies you kill affected by Elemental Ailments have a chance to spawn a Mana Remnant, and Critically Hitting a target with Elemental Ailments spawns a Mana Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Mana Remnant grants you Mana which can Overflow maximum Mana.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 攻擊, 持續, 範圍效果, 物理, 捷光環, 遣散
增益效果,攻擊,持續,範圍效果,物理,捷光環,遣散
啟動期間，擊殺一名帶有失血的敵人會造成一次鮮血爆炸，根據累積的失血量對周遭敵人造成物理攻擊傷害。此攻擊不基於你的武器傷害，但是會受到一部分累積的[BloodLoss|失血影響。若敵人為普通或魔法則會摧毀他們的屍體。此一爆炸同時有機率加劇流血。
hiddenEn: Buff, Attack, Persistent, AoE, Physical, Herald, Payoff

While active, killing an enemy with Blood Loss will cause a bloody explosion that deals Physical Attack damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your Weapon, but is partially based on their accumulated Blood Loss. The explosion destroys their Corpse if the enemy was Normal or Magic, and has a chance to Aggravate Bleeding.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 範圍效果, 物理, 持續時間
增益效果,持續,範圍效果,物理,持續時間
在你存在範圍中的敵人會週期性地累積鮮血沸騰。當它們死亡後，沸騰的鮮血便會引爆，並對其附近的敵人施加腐化之血。
hiddenEn: Enemies in your Presence accumulate blood boils periodically. When they die, the boils pop applying Corrupted Blood to enemies near them.

hiddenZh: 增益效果, 持續, 觸發, 火焰, 主要
增益效果,持續,觸發,火焰,主要
啟動期間，當你點燃敵人時獲得能量，並在到達最大能量時觸發插槽中的法術。
hiddenEn: While active, gains Energy when you Ignite enemies and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

hiddenZh: 召喚物, 持續, 號令, 物理
召喚克拉里，一名聽從你的號令的無敵沙之巨靈召喚物。克拉里僅會在你對他發出號令時行動，做出極易暴擊的迅捷擊中。
hiddenEn: Summon Kelari, an invulnerable Sand Djinn Minion, to do your bidding. Kelari will only act when you Command him to do so. Kelari delivers swift Hits with massive Critical Hit potential.

ambientZh: 可以在技能面板管理技能。
ambientEn: Skills can be managed in the Skills Panel.
